Albin Clavin is a Sordish politician who currently serves as a member of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland since 1949. He is a member of USP and regarded to be the leader of the progressive faction of the party. 

Albin has recently risen to significance during the Alphonso administration as an aggressive debater and a strong supporter of Ewald Alphonso and his policies. He was instrumental in the passing of the free market reforms of Alphonso. He became famed for his controversial speeches in the Grand National Assembly, and was labelled as the face of “a new generation” of the USP by the media.

After the recession, he joined the calls for a congress to elect a new presidential nominee and abandoned his support to Ewald Alphonso. Albin nominated himself as the next candidate but did not get much support in the congress, which eventually led to the candidacy of Anton Rayne. He has been calling for constitutional reforms with the election of Rayne.

Bernard Circas is a Sordish poet, novelist, short story writer and communist politician. He is acclaimed for his lyrical flow and was regarded to be the leader of the Sordish avant-garde.

His early writings were heavily influenced by the social, cultural, and economic problems of his home city of Deyr. His work earned him the description of a ‘romantic communist.’

He joined the Red Youth during the Sordish Civil War, and fled Sordland after the war was over, surviving the purge of Tarquin Soll. He moved to United Contana and studied sociology at the Communist University of Kyow. There, he was influenced by the artistic experiments of Contanan poets who advocated futurism, as well as the ideological vision of Malenyev.

His literary works are widely regarded as seminal contributions to Sordish literature and have garnered numerous international accolades. He was the second individual from Sordland to receive the prestigious Vulpitzer Award in 1948, following Herman Equa. Due to his political views, however, his works have been subject to a ban in Sordland since 1930.

In 1950, Bernard returned to Sordland following the departure of Tarquin Soll. He organized strikes against Sordish government’s failure to include amnesty laws and started to become a popular figure in Sordish politics. He ran as an independent in the 1953 General Elections and became the first communist to be elected to the Grand National Assembly of Sordland.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Bernard Circas

Gloria Tory is a Sordish politician, member of assembly and the current Speaker of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland since 1949. She has been a member of the assembly since 1937.

After graduating from Holsord State University, Gloria was elected as the president of the student organization, Republican Youth. She supported the democratic revolutionaries and was credited for organizing several major student rallies during the last years of the Sordish monarchy.

Before her election to the assembly, she worked at several jobs, including a lobbying firm and a school of public speaking and debating. In 1929, she became a member of the United Sordland National Committee from Vesord.

Gloria rose quickly in USP after she was elected to the Grand National Assembly in 1937. She was appointed as a special adviser to the Minister of Interior in 1938, before being brought as the frontbench spokeswoman for Home Affairs in 1942, and the spokeswoman for Education in 1944. In 1949, she was elected as the Speaker of the Grand National Assembly, in protest against President Ewald Alphonso's reformist agenda. She is the first woman in Sordland to hold that position.

She was a strong critic of Ewald Alphonso’s presidency, and she became famed for her obstructions in the assembly of some of his policies. Regarded as a charismatic politician and a tough negotiator, she is credited for major lobbying incidents within the USP which shifted the political landscape during the last decade. After the 1953 elections, she was elected speaker for a second time.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Gloria Tory

Katarina Horten is a Sordish labour leader, politician and activist of Bludish descent, member of the assembly and the current spokesperson of the Labour Union of Sordland.

Born in Deyr, Bergia, to a Sordish Bludish family, Horten began her working life as a manual laborer before studying law at the Holsord State University. Relocating to Holsord, where she married, she got involved in the Sordland headquarters of the Watchtower of Human Rights (WHR), through which she helped laborers register to vote.

In 1942, she became the WHR's Sordland director. Later in 1948, she left the WHR to join the Labour Union of Sordland through which she launched an insurance scheme and a local newspaper for Bergian farmworkers. She began organizing strikes among farmworkers, some of which had been successful. Horten is known for her emphasis on direct but nonviolent tactics to pressure the state and the farm owners into granting the demands of the strikers. Receiving much support from labor and leftist groups, she was appointed as the spokesperson of the Labour Union of Sordland in 1950.

In the 1953 elections, she ran as an independent and was elected to be a member of the assembly.

Manoly Suheil is a Sordish politician, Member of Assembly and the Group Deputy Chairwoman of the People’s Freedom and Justice Party (PFJP.) She has been serving in the Grand National Assembly of Sordland since 1949.

Suheil has recently risen to significance during PFJP’s opposition against President Alphonso’s government as an aggressive debater. She was a harsh critic of the free market reforms and became famed for her internal opposition against Frens Ricter for his support of Alphonso’s policies.

As a staunch anti-Sollist, she was behind the organization of several major protests against Tarquin Soll in the 1940’s. She later became renowned for her support for the Agno-Sordish and Bludish minorities. She is regarded to be the leader of the radical progressives within the PFJP and holds enormous influence among the leftist members of the party. She is highly critical of Frens Ricter’s support for economically liberal policies, arguing he is ‘pulling the party away from social democracy.’

Suheil was allegedly blackmailed numerous times by the party leadership for her radical stance, yet was finally offered to be the spokesperson of the PFJP by Frens Ricter after a steep rise in her popularity. She has been the Group Deputy Chairwoman of the PFJP since 1953.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Manoly Suheil

Mansoun Leke is a Sordish politician of Bludish descent, member of the assembly and the current leader of the independents in the Grand National Assembly of Sordland. He was the leader of the pro-Bludish Workers Party of Bludia between 1948 and 1949. He is a strong advocate for the rights of religious and ethnic minorities.

During his education in Holsord State University in the Department of Literature in 1925, he faced political problems due to his Bludish background and his left-leaning views, which forced him to leave school without finishing his degree. He later enrolled in Deyr University of Culture and graduated with a degree in Merkopan History.

After the Izzam Incident in 1933, and the ban on the Bludish Freedom Party, he returned to his hometown in Uziren and campaigned to organize the Bludish minority under a new democratic political movement. He was allegedly invited to join the militant Bludish Freedom Front by Dewlen Arge personally. He heavily protested against Arge’s call for a full-scale insurgency in the region of Bergia, arguing that ‘violence would only result in more violence’.

In 1948, he joined the Workers Party of Bludia. The same year, he was elected to be the leader of the party and ran as a presidential candidate in the 1949 elections. He coined the slogan, ‘peace in Bludia, peace in Sordland, peace in the world.’

In the ‘49 elections, he got 6% of the general vote, failing to pass the election threshold. He later resigned from his position despite protests from his own party and ran as an independent in the 1953 elections to bypass the threshold. He was elected as a Member of Assembly in 1953.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Mansoun Leke

Remus Holstron is a Sordish politician, Member of Assembly, the founding member of the National Front Party (NFP), and its current Group Deputy Chairman. He has been serving in the Grand National Assembly of Sordland since 1937. He is nicknamed ‘the Iron Wall’ by the NFP supporters.

Holstron is allegedly one of the soldiers who worked under General Luderin that helped establish the Young Sords. He is believed to have been active within the organization during the Sordish Civil War. He was blamed by the Bludish Freedom Party and the Communist Party of Sordland for having been behind many of the atrocities that took place against the Bludish and the communists between 1927 to 1930. He has denied such claims and holds no official membership position in the Young Sords.

As a founding member of the NFP, he promoted ethnonationalist policies in the 1930’s and became a famous figure for his aggressive speeches in the Grand National Assembly. Kibener heavily protested against his political stance, saying that ‘Mr. Holstron and many others in our leadership created an unapproachable and unreasonable political movement which is expected to lose in every election.’

With the rise of Kesaro Kibener in the 1940’s, he lost his influence in the party and resigned in 1949 after Kibener was voted in as the leader. He was later invited by Kibener to rejoin the party ahead of the 1953 elections and was appointed as the party’s Group Deputy Chairman.

Konrath Koronti is the CEO and majority shareholder of the HOS Conglomerate. He is the man who created the famous Koronti brand through his highly successful business ventures and motivational quotes that inspired generations of entrepreneurs. He always promoted a victory no matter the cost approach to making a business a success which also drew criticism from those who parted ways with him on his ventures.

The rise of the Heart of Sordland Conglomerate is entirely on the shoulders of Konrath Koronti who acquired small companies in critical industries where Sordland was lagging behind. His competition and performance oriented attitude allowed him to disrupt these industries and to dominate them.

He has five children whom he is said to have raised without excessive wealth and privilege.

Marcel Koronti is a Sordish businessman, philanthropist, entrepreneur who is the son of the media proprietor Konrath Koronti. He operates the HOS Advertising, the largest advertising company in Sordland. He is also a board member of the HOS, Sordland’s largest conglomerate operating in the media, energy, construction, trade and tourism industries. He previously served as the chairman of HOS Resorts, a luxury hotel group with 12 destinations in 8 countries.

Koronti obtained a bachelor's degree from the Perla School of Business and a master's degree in media and communications from Harcard University in Ventrie City, Arcasia.

In 1940, Koronti joined the Sordish Broadcasting Corporation as vice president in charge of advertising, before being transferred to the HOS Resorts chain by Konrath Koronti three years later. He transformed HOS Resorts from a leading hotel chain in Sordland into an international powerhouse through his expansion of the brand into 7 different countries.

In 1950, he left HOS Resorts and started operating the HOS Advertising, the advertising company within the HOS Media Group of the HOS conglomerate.

Mikail Aven is a Sordish businessman, economist and statesman who serves as the co-chairman of the National Business Council of Sordland.

Born in Lenkurg, Agnland, to an Agno-Sordish family, Aven studied Economics in the Lachaven Business School before starting his work at Gasom. In the 1930’s, he worked as a financial advisor and later as a project director at the corporation.

In 1940, Aven started working at the Sordland office of the OMEC, where he contributed extensively to Agnland’s economic planning. He gained nationwide reputation for his work in the city of Arvory throughout the 1940’s, which helped the city go through an economic boom.

Aven was later transferred to OMEC’s Agnolia headquarters, where he oversaw the economic guidance of small Agnolian fishing settlements to transform into major economic centers. He gained international fame for his advice which lifted Gilberdam from poverty, and was given the Medal for Meritorious Service by the Agnolian government.

In 1949, Aven returned to Sordland by invitation from the Ministry of Economy and started his work for the government as an economist. In 1950, he was appointed as the co-chairman of the National Business Council.

Walter Tusk is a millionaire businessman, investor and the current spokesperson of the Lotherberg Group. He owns the Ekonomists Group, which publishes the well-known newspaper, the Ekonomists and he is a major shareholder of Sordish steel company, Bergia Steel. According to Lachaven Times, he is the 8th richest Sord, as of 1953.

Walter began his career as an engineer after graduating with a degree in Electrical Engineering from Kingshill University, one of the League of Trident. Later on, Walter established several small businesses with his friends from college, including a restaurant, a company that imported cigarettes and a car wash business. After his successes as a businessman, he formed a very successful company that produced machinery parts and electrical wires, which earned him millions of Sordish Ren.

During the largely unregulated privatization of former state-controlled industries of late 1940’s, Walter was able to acquire the shares of several important companies for a fraction of their estimated market value. He later became a member of the influential Lotherberg Group. He is credited for his large contributions into the natural resource industry in Sordland. Walter is also known for his international ties due to his investments in Lespia, Agnolia, and Arcasia.

Walter is generally regarded as the leader of the Lotherberg Group and due to his connections, the most important businessman in Sordland.

Ciara Walda is an academician and politician who serves as the Minister of Education, Technology & Research of Sordland. She became a member of the United Sordland Party before the 1953 elections. Prior to becoming a minister, she was elected and served as an independent MP.

As a member of the assembly, Ciara has been aggressively promoting educational reforms and supported socialist politics. Although she has been targeted many times for her ideals, she remains to be a popular politician, particularly among women. She is a staunch supporter of women’s rights and slowly gaining fame among the reformists for her progressive rhetoric.

Before her political career, Ciara taught philosophy and political sciences in several major universities, including the Lachaven Business School and Deyr University of Culture. She has written many academic articles, some of which were published in well-respected journals world wide.

Ciara joined United Sordland to campaign for Anton Rayne’s candidacy in an effort to reform the governing body of the party. She was appointed as a minister after the elections.

Deivid Wisci is a diplomat, ambassador and politician who serves as the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Sordland. He became a member of the United Sordland Party in 1949 after Tarquin Soll’s resignation. Beside his career, he is known by many through his father, Artor S. Wisci, the founder of the Republic of Sordland.

He entered the service of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in 1923 and worked on many positions at various departments. Between 1925 and 1927, Wisci taught ‘’Applied International Law and Disputes’’ at the faculty of Political Science of Deyr University of Culture. In 1949, he was appointed ambassador to Staalport.

Deivid is still remembered for helping out to 10.000 immigrants of Sordish and Bludish origin while serving as Consul General in Luco, Lespia in 1929. He became a respected name in the diplomatic scene in the Markian region. He has been promoting social democracy and human rights in Sordland for decades. Deivid is also known for criticizing the United Sordland Party for oppressing the Bludish people, acknowledging the ‘’Bludish Issue’’ which made him a target for the Sollists and the nationalists. He eventually joined the party during Alphonso’s presidency.

Due to his connection to President Artor S. Wisci, Deivid is still seen as a controversial member of the USP. He is known to be a nonpartisan, and an opponent of Tarquin Soll’s policies. Although he publicly criticizes his own party, he worked closely with Anton Rayne and became the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade in 1953.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Deivid Wisci

Gus Manger is a politician and businessman who serves as the Minister of Agriculture and Rural Development in the Rayne administration. Gus Manger has been a United Sordland Party member since 1933 and served as the Minister of Development under the Alphonso government. He is the only cabinet member who managed to retain a ministerial position from the Alphonso administration.

Gus was born in Valgen in 1899 to a family of old landowners who cultivated many farms in the Gruni region and exported crops, fruits, and other products to Lespia. He studied business at the University of Valgen, and later worked with OMEC in 1931 to help develop local agricultural, logistical, and energy companies. Manger used his OMEC connections to help Gasom, a company that contracted him, to attract top engineering talent.

After helping his home region find foreign direct investment, he diversified his investments. Gus saw great potential in Anrica, as a middle-ground between the most prominent cities. He made significant investments there in the early 1940s, founding and running a successful logistics and tourism company. His strong relations with the city led him to acquire minority ownership in FC Anrica, the city's football club.

In 1943 he was appointed deputy to the Minister of Economy, Commerce, and Energy of Tarquin Soll's 4th cabinet. After the party congress of 1946 and the loss of party leadership of Tarquin Soll, Gus joined the Alphonso government as Minister of Development. Gus was particularly successful in helping rural poverty reduction through international investment attraction, arranging high-value export routes for locally produced agricultural goods, and adjusting import and export taxes to drive the generated economic value up in Sordland. 

Between 1950 and 1952, he was crucial in arranging landmark trade deals with countries like Rizia, Lespia, and Anraka to improve the trade deficit of Sordland and help the economy to stabilize. Manger worked tirelessly during and after the 51 recession with the "Three Econs," consisting of Edith Agnoc, Mikail Aven, and Symon Holl, and helped Sordland avoid economic depression.

He eventually supported Anton Rayne in 1953 after the collapse of the Alphonso cabinet. He was given the adjusted position of Minister of Agriculture and Rural Development in the Rayne administration in 1954.

Iosef Lancea is a Sordish national security professional who serves as the Minister of Defense and Security of Sordland. He has been a member of the United Sordland Party since its formation in 1929. Prior to his position as minister, he held the position of Inspector General of the Army, serving directly under the Chief of Staff of the Sordish Army.

He was a captain during the Sordland Civil War and served under the command of Colonel Tarquin Soll before his presidency. He gained nation-wide fame after his heroism and accomplishments as major during the Wehlen Civil War, which also earned him the highest military order.

Iosef became a popular figure after the wars, and still is well respected among the nationalists. He is credited for several major military operations and known to be an influential figure in the Sordish Armed Forces. He has been promoting the reformation of the army into a professional rather than a conscripted force.

He was a big critic of Ewald Alphonso’s policies. He gave his support to Anton Rayne and lobbied for major conservative support in the 1953 elections for the USP. He was appointed by the General Staff as the Minister of Defense and Security.

Lileas Graf is the current Minister of Interior of Sordland. She is a member of the United Sordland Party since its formation in 1929. Before that, she was a staff sergeant in the Women’s Army Corps. Then, she served as the mayor of Arvory from 1940 to 1947, and the mayor of Holsord from 1948 to 1952.

Lileas started her political career as an elected official on Arvory City Council. Her tenure as public advocate saw a reformation of various housing, finance and security policies. Then, she was elected mayor of Arvory in 1940 and her accomplishments in the city brought her nationwide popularity. This prompted Tarquin Soll to pick her to replace the mayor of Holsord. Her policies on urban planning and public education transformed Holsord’s economy and boosted her popularity in the capital. She is currently one of the central figures in the United Sordland party.

Lileas is credited for the economic booms in both Arvory and Holsord, and known for supporting socially conservative politics throughout her career. She is respected as an expert on urban development and police relations. As one of the most influential supporters of Anton Rayne’s candidacy, She inarguably brought with her a large conservative support in the elections. Soon after, she left her position as the mayor of Holsord to become a minister under the Rayne administration.

Lucian Galade, born in 1899, is a notable figure in Sordish politics, presently holding the position of chief strategist to the President of Sordland. He has been an active member of the United Sordland Party since 1937 and has held a variety of significant roles within the party throughout his career.

Galade's academic background is in sociology and law. He studied sociology at Kingshill University before pursuing law at Imperial Markian University. He completed these demanding courses of study in an unusually short period of time, from 1917 to 1920. A gap exists in the public record of Galade's activities for about a decade following his graduation.

Galade's career reemerges in the public record in the 1930s when he worked as a lawyer and chief strategy officer at multiple think tanks and public relations agencies in Lachaven. He transitioned into politics in the early 1930s, providing legal counsel to several influential assembly members in Holsord. He also served as the spokesperson for the United Sordland National Committee during the second and third terms of Soll's presidency. Additionally, Galade was an advisor to the Interior Minister during Tarquin Soll's final presidential term in the 1940s.

Galade is recognized in political circles for his strategic acumen, and his role in recent electoral successes has further enhanced his reputation. While his contributions often go unnoticed by the public, he is highly regarded within the cabinet for his extensive experience and expertise in law and media.

Galade was one of the earliest supporters of Anton Rayne's presidential candidacy in 1953. His strategic input was crucial to the success of Rayne's election campaign. Following Rayne's victory, Galade took on his current role as the president's chief strategist, a position which solidifies his influence in Sordish politics.

Nia Morgna is a politician and attorney from the Sordish region of Bergia, who serves as the Minister of Justice and Law. She became a member of the United Sordland Party in 1949, and served as the Vice Minister of Justice during the Alphonso administration.

Before her political career, she worked as an attorney in Deyr and also taught Law in Deyr University of Culture. Although she came from a wealthy family, they lost their assets during the National Autarky Plan of the 1930’s.

Nia was a strong critic of Tarquin Soll’s programs and vocal about her opposition to the Supreme Court’s authority on state matters. Due to her expertise on Sordish law, she was appointed by Ewald Alphonso as the Vice Minister of Law in 1949.

During her role as the vice minister, Nia is credited to the defacto running of the Ministry of Justice under heavy pressure from the Sollist elements in the administration. She earned her reputation from her fight against corruption in the ministry among protests from the Supreme Court. She is regarded as one of the most experienced attorneys who worked for the government. She eventually gave her support to Anton Rayne and was appointed as the Minister of Justice and Law in 1953.

Paskal Beniwoll is an author and Sordish government official who serves as the Minister of Health, Social Affairs and Labor. He is a member of the United Sordland Party since 1942. His government career began in 1949 when Ewald Alphonso appointed him to the Sordland Civil Service Commission. He also served as president of the University of Valgen and Gelsord School of Medicine.

Before his political career, Paskal wrote 8 books, one of which was a best-seller called ‘’The Unfortunate Man,’’ where he tells the story of a family of poverty-stricken miners. He became known as a writer who depicts the struggles of Sordish life from a realistic frame, which brought him praise from the middle class and the civil rights groups.

He was elected to the assembly in 1945 and advocated for new workplace safety regulations and a workers compensation program. He was an important force in the shaping of the nation’s first social security policies. Initially a supporter of Ewald Alphonso’s programs, Paskal eventually turned against the free market reforms and the president’s management of them, stating that it drained badly needed resources away from welfare programs. He gave his support to Anton Rayne in 1953, and was appointed as a minister after the elections.

He is married to Evelyn Vectern, who became a controversial figure because of her pro-government articles when she was working as a journalist at the Holsord Post.

Regarded as a centrist, he was among the group of politicians who supported Ewald Alphonso against Tarquin Soll and campaigned for a change in the party. He was also the leading figure behind Anton Rayne during his campaign for the 1953 elections. He is credited for his large contributions to the campaign and the party.

In 1956, he was involved in a huge scandal when his intimate relationship with a foreign spy was revealed. He was blamed for leaking classified information but was publicly defended by President Rayne and his case was dismissed.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Petr Vectern

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Symon Holl is a politician and businessman who serves as the Minister of Economy, Commerce and Energy of Sordland. He is a member of the United Sordland Party and the co-chairman of the National Business Council.

As the former chairman of the Central Bank of Sordland, Symon is known to possess great influence over the economy of Sordland, and he is regarded as one of the top experts in Sordland on financial matters. He was a big supporter of the free market reforms of Ewald Alphonso, but criticized his other policies and blamed the recession on his rushed handling of the reforms.

Symon is often famed for his promotion of free market economy in Sordland and his analyses of the economic boom in Arcasia. He wrote several books and articles on the economic inequality in the Markian region, which earned him praise from economists both in Sordland and abroad.

Symon gave his support to Anton Rayne after the recession and campaigned with him throughout the whole election process. Eventually, he was appointed as the Minister of Economy, Commerce and Energy.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Symon Holl

Symon Holl is a politician and businessman who served as the Minister of Economy, Commerce and Energy of Sordland from 1953 to 1957. He was a member of the United Sordland Party and the co-chairman of the National Business Council.

As the former chairman of the Central Bank of Sordland, Symon is known to possess great influence over the economy of Sordland, and he is regarded as one of the top experts in Sordland on financial matters. Symon is often famed for his promotion of free market economy in Sordland and his analyses of the economic boom in Arcasia. He wrote several books and articles on the economic inequality in the Markian region, which earned him praise from economists both in Sordland and abroad.

Symon gave his support to Anton Rayne after the recession and campaigned with him throughout the whole election process. He was appointed as the Minister of Economy, Commerce and Energy in 1953. In 1957, he resigned from the cabinet in protest to President Rayne.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Symon Holl

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Deana Rayne is the daughter of Anton Rayne and Monica Rayne. She is attending elementary school in Holsord.

In a brief interview, Monica Rayne said that she was named after her grandmother who came in the 1860’s to Sordland from Agnolia with hopes to start a new life.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Deana Rayne

CodexEntryProperties.Title: Franc Rayne

CodexEntryProperties.Description: Franc Rayne is the son of Anton Rayne and Monica Rayne. He studied at the Holsord Markian High school and currently studies Fine Arts at Harcard University in Arcasia.

CodexEntryProperties.Title: Franc Rayne

CodexEntryProperties.Description: Monica Rayne is the current First Lady of Sordland. She was born in Lachaven to parents with Agno-Sordish background. She has a degree in sociology and has worked as a social worker and later, as the partnerships manager in Magnus Cartus and campaign assistant of the Sordish League of Women before her marriage to Anton Rayne.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Monica Rayne

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Monica Rayne has been the First Lady of Sordland from 1953 until her divorce with Anton Rayne in 1957. She was born in Lachaven to parents with Agno-Sordish background. She has a degree in sociology and has worked as a social worker and later, as the partnerships manager in Magnus Cartus and campaign assistant of the Sordish League of Women before her marriage to Anton Rayne.

She became the first First Lady to divorce an acting president in 1957.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Monica Rayne

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Monica Rayne is a women’s rights activist who is also the current First Lady of Sordland. She was born in Lachaven to parents with Agno-Sordish background. She has a degree in sociology and has worked as a social worker and later, as the partnerships manager in Magnus Cartus and campaign assistant of the Sordish League of Women before her marriage to Anton Rayne.

She became the spokesperson for the Commission for Women's Rights in 1957.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Monica Rayne

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Alma Saltana is the current Prime Minister of the Republic of Morella and the leader of the left-wing coalition Morellan Unified Front.

Born into a Qinali-Morellan family of modest means in the capital city of Cavette, she developed a passion for politics and activism at an early age. During university, she completed a year abroad at the People's University of United Contana; the Malenyevist teachings she was exposed to there informed her later work as a labor lawyer and community organizer.

She eventually joined the Morellan Social Democrat party, where she quickly rose to the rank of vice-chairwoman. Seizing the opportunity presented by the economic crisis of the 1940s, she successfully united the country's left-leaning parties to form the Morellan Unified Front coalition, which replaced Morella's right-wing, authoritarian government in 1950. 

As a PM, she has enacted significant social reforms, emphasizing the importance of the redistribution of wealth and the role of the state in providing for the welfare of all citizens. However, her political rivals have criticized the speed with which these changes were implemented and their potential for alienating Morella's international allies.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Alma Saltana

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Grand Duke Axel Reinhart is the ruler of the Grand Duchy of Pales. He is the youngest scion of the Reinhart family, who have ruled the Grand Duchy since the conclusion of the War of Rizian Succession in 1810. As the younger brother of Duke Njolma, he was groomed from a young age to succeed the throne, receiving an education in Palesian, Rizian and Valgish from a cadre of elite tutors and prestigious institutions.

Growing up, he was often featured in the international tabloids for his good looks and variety of interests. He has displayed a penchant for equestrian sports, classical music, and archaeological exploration, and his pursuits have often been marked by a blend of thrill and scholarly curiosity. 

His charisma made him a popular figure among the Palesian and Rizian speakers of Pales alike, and following his brother Njolma's abdication in 1948, he was a natural choice for successor.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Axel Reinhart

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Beatrice Livingston, born in 1905, is the Queen of the Kingdom of Rumburg and the proclaimed ruler of All of Northern Merkopa. She acceded to the throne in November 1921 at the age of sixteen following the death of her father, King Alfred II. Under Rumburg's Regency Act, she reigned in her minority until eighteen, with executive authority exercised by a regency headed by Regent Duke Eadric Wulfsbury.

The opening phase of her reign coincided with the War of Broken Wills (1921–1924), which began under the regency and ended with the Treaty of Konstantium, co-signed by Beatrice alongside Lord Chancellor Godric Falkenridge. The war and its outcome became one of the defining political victories of her reign, consolidating her authority and shaping her reputation as a ruler capable of advancing Rumburgian interests through both military and diplomatic channels.

After assuming full authority, she reigned as a constitutional monarch through major political changes, including centralization measures, secularization reforms, and the dissolution and integration of northern territories into the kingdom. In 1926, Rumburg aided Rizia with supplies during the Uprising after King Valero requested assistance. In domestic politics she initially aligned with the Crown Preservation Party, while maintaining differences on religious policy, a conflict that culminated in a political break in 1928. After the rupture she recalibrated her governing alliances, building new court and parliamentary partnerships, with her later internal security agenda and external posture more often associated with GRUP-backed arguments for forward frontier influence.

Shaped by the costly wars of the previous century that slowed Rumburg's advance and strained its institutions, Beatrice is often described as preferring legal and diplomatic solutions where possible, while treating force as a last resort when other channels failed. In foreign policy, the Queen codified her approach as the Beatrice Doctrine, presented under the title "The Great Unification," framed in royal messaging as the survival and growth of monarchies after the Century of Revolutions. Following the socialist revolution in Valgsland, she cancelled Alfred II's plans for an Eastern Merkopan Pact with Valgsland and instead pursued closer commercial ties with Arcasia through major trade deals, while also advancing GRACE as Rumburg's primary framework for coordination among aligned monarchies. 

In 1932, she supported closer ties with Rizia and helped arrange the marriage of her sister, Princess Lena Livingston, to Prince Romus Toras (later King Romus Toras), a union that formalized a dynastic link between the two royal houses. Beatrice gained infamy for selling weapons to both the attackers and defenders during the Wehlen Civil War, and despite official denials, Rumburg is widely believed to have been heavily involved in both the Wehlen Civil War and the Sordish Civil War, drawing sharp criticism from United Contana and diplomatic friction with Arcasia.

Court politics became more prominent in the late 1930s and 1940s, including an intensified use of Livingston and allied noble marriages into GRUP-aligned circles as part of broader bloc management and elite consolidation. By the 1950s, Rumburg's policy under the Queen was increasingly shaped by industrial resource demands and raw material supply concerns alongside its external commitments. She has periodically faced republican sentiment and criticism of the royal family, particularly in response to reforms viewed as reducing the practical authority of the Parliament of Rumburg.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Beatrice Livingston

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Dwight Walker is an Arcasian politician and businessman with Rumburgian heritage who currently serves as the President of the Republic of Arcasia. He is widely recognized for authoring the Walker Plan, a transformative economic initiative that revitalized struggling Merkopan economies, and for championing the establishment of the Arcasian Treaty Organization, a continental alliance opposing the spread of Malenyevism.

Born in Ventrie City to a prominent Rummish industrial family around the turn of the century, Walker pursued a degree in international affairs before enlisting in the Arcasian Naval Forces. He served during the final stages of the Century of Revolutions, where he gained recognition as a patriotic advocate for democracy and Arcasian internationalism.

In the 1930s, Walker entered national politics and was elected to the House of Representatives as a rising figure in the Democracy Party. He briefly served as Vice President under President Renald Revoutier, but stepped down following a political rift with the party’s leadership.

He returned to regional politics and was elected Governor-Premier of the Région Fédérale de Ventrie in the early 1940s. In 1944, he introduced the Walker Plan, a regional blueprint emphasizing deregulation, tax reduction, infrastructure development, and private investment. The plan’s rapid success reignited his national profile.

With growing national support and backing from the business elite, Walker broke from the Democracy Party and established the New Democratic Concord, a platform centered on economic liberalism and technocratic reform. He won the 1946 presidential election following the retirement of President Renald Revoutier, defeating the Reformist Union, then led by veteran statesman Doniese Gierre. Walker won the presidency with strong backing from urban industrial regions and a realigned center-right bloc.

Taking office in 1947, Walker began the nationwide implementation of the Walker Plan, introducing sweeping deregulation, tax cuts, and public-private infrastructure initiatives. These reforms rapidly stimulated growth, reduced poverty, and shaped the vision of the Arcasian Dream: a national ideal built on personal merit, market opportunity, and upward mobility. During this period, Charles Devereaux rose to leadership within the Reformist Union and began advocating for expanded welfare programs and stronger social protections as a counterpoint to Walker’s economic model.

Walker’s presidency also marked the expansion of the Arcasian Treaty Organization, officially founded under Revoutier’s administration. Under his leadership, the ATO expanded and became a strategic bulwark against the Contanan Security Pact, aligning capitalist nations through joint defense, trade integration, and the deployment of advanced weapons systems across allied territories.

Walker’s policies redefined Arcasia’s role as a global capitalist power. By promoting limited government, open markets, and the rise of major private corporations, especially in defense, energy, and technology, his leadership solidified Arcasia’s ideological contrast with United Contana and reshaped the political economy of the Merkopan region.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Dwight Walker

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Emmerich Hegel is a Valgslandian politician and communist revolutionary who currently serves as the Chancellor of the Democratic Republic of Valgsland. He is also the chairman of the People’s Party of Valgsland. Hegel played a key role in the 1920 Revolution and the founding of the republic, and later became known for initiating a new ideological framework called Valgslandian Socialism, marked by structural reforms and a reduction in repression.

Hegel began his political career as a political commissar during the revolution, fighting alongside Wilhelm Ulbrik, the principal architect of the revolutionary movement and a staunch adherent of Malenyevism from United Contana. Following the establishment of the Democratic Republic, Hegel helped build the People’s Party and rose through its ranks.

By 1925, he had been appointed Presiding Secretary of the People’s Assembly and Chair of the Council for Regional Economic Coordination. These roles allowed Hegel to oversee early postrevolutionary reconstruction efforts and formulate ideas for decentralized economic management. However, under Ulbrik's rule, many of these structures remained symbolic or functionally ineffective due to tight central control and rigid bureaucratic systems.
In 1930, Hegel delivered a landmark address to the People’s Congress, where he publicly outlined the principles of Valgslandian Socialism, advocating for a participatory and decentralized model of governance. The speech shocked the revolutionary establishment but did not lead to direct confrontation or governmental paralysis, and Hegel retained his position within the party.

Despite mounting ideological differences with Ulbrik behind closed doors, Hegel remained a loyal party figure. In 1936, he was appointed Deputy Chancellor, officially becoming second in command. From this position, Hegel began to gradually transform the symbolic structures of regional governance into pseudo functional mechanisms, enabling limited participation and experimentation in local economic councils without fully dislodging Ulbrik’s centralized control.

During this period, Hegel continued to support Ulbrik’s hardline domestic policies, including widespread purges of perceived anticommunist dissidents, and played a prominent role in directing international solidarity campaigns, particularly in support of anticolonial movements in Rika and Xina.

Following Ulbrik’s sudden death from a heart attack in 1940, Hegel was elected Chancellor by the People’s Congress. He immediately began a program of de Ulbrikization, condemning past excesses, ending the purges, and consolidating civilian institutions over military or bureaucratic organs. He restructured the People’s Party and distanced its ideological line from orthodox Malenyevism, fully embracing the framework he had introduced a decade earlier.

In late 1946, following the formation of the Contanan Security Pact, Chancellor Hegel led Valgsland to become its first member after United Contana. While Valgsland’s governance model diverged from Contana’s centralized approach, Hegel maintained close diplomatic and economic ties with the Malenyevist leadership, even as he pursued independent trade and development agreements with former territories of the Valgos Empire. 

Hegel’s reforms reshaped Valgsland into a more participatory socialist republic and elevated his legacy as the theorist and implementer of Valgslandian Socialism, a model that blended ideological continuity with institutional decentralization.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Emmerich Hegel

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Jorga Azmal is the Supreme Wiseman of Derdian Golcondism, and therefore the leader of the Nurist Republic of Derdia.

Azmal grew up within the Golcondist community of Outer Neael, where he achieved the rank of Adept at just 16 years old. He studied Wruhecist philosophy at Neael University before becoming a disciple of Rasma Atafor, Derdia's first Supreme Wiseman. In the early 1940s, he published a book based on Atafor's teachings that was widely distributed to schools and households across the country. When Atafor died in 1945, Azmal was unanimously voted in as his successor.

Azmal has mostly continued the strict religion-based policies of his predecessor; the only notable departure has been his focus on weapons programs as a "necessary step towards achieving Golconda". He lives in a heavily guarded compound built into the mountains above Neael, which he runs as a self-sustaining Golcondist community, disconnected from the city's water and energy grid.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Jorga Azmal

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua is a Contanan revolutionary, politician, and political theorist who has been serving as the head of government of United Contana since 1910. He is the architect of Malenyevism, a unique variant of Marcian socio-economics. Chavatangakwunua played a significant role in transforming Kontania, and subsequently United Contana, into a communist state governed by the Contanan Communist Party.

Born into a poor family in the Kontanian Empire (now part of United Contana), Chavatangakwunua was drawn to revolutionary socialist politics following his brother's execution. He relocated to Kyow in 1901, where he became a senior theorist of Marcian Socio-economics. Inspired by Karlos Marcia's political theory, Chavatangakwunua developed Malenyevism upon joining the Marcianist Contanan Labour Party.

Chavatangakwunua was instrumental in the party's ideological split, leading the Rotski faction against other factions and promoting Malenyevism within the party. He advocated for the transformation of the Century of Revolutions into a Contana-wide proletarian revolution, which he believed would result in the overthrow of capitalism and its replacement with socialism. Chavatangakwunua led the Rotskis during the 1907 Revolution, ultimately declaring a communist republic and deposing the King.

Under Chavatangakwunua's leadership, United Contana underwent rapid industrialization and collectivization through the implementation of a command economy and the pursuit of socialist reforms. This strategy led to the development and modernization of the entire continent. Chavatangakwunua's ideology has been adapted and interpreted into different schools of thought worldwide, with the number of Marco-Malenyevists steadily increasing, cementing his position as one of the most influential leaders of the century.

Chavatangakwunua is particularly renowned for his massive education and science plan, which has elevated United Contana to a position of technological supremacy in the region, rivaling Arcasia. Through his commitment to educational reforms and investment in scientific research, United Contana has emerged as a powerhouse in technological innovation, driving economic growth and solidifying its status as a global superpower.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Maartin Van Hoorten is an Agnolian politician who currently serves as the Prime Minister of the Republic of Agnolia. He is the youngest politician to hold office in the government of Agnolia.

Van Hoorten became the leader of the centrist Nurist Democratic Union of Agnolia in 1951, after his extensive campaign to bring Agnolian economy out of recession. He has been a staunch promoter of privatization and relaxed immigration laws.

After his election as prime minister in 1952, he promised to find new trade partners and replace old ‘unjust’ treaties with fairer ones. During his first years as prime minister, he brought Agnolia closer to the west, signing mutual cooperation agreements with Arcasia and Lespia. He strongly promoted the free movement of people across Merkopa and increased Agnolia’s presence in the OMEC and Alliance of Nations.

During Van Hoorten’s term, Agnolia’s steel production greatly increased and the volume of Agnolian exports to Western Merkopan countries doubled. In order to strengthen Agnolia’s economy and its independence, he started a new initiative to discover new natural resources in the Markian Sea.

Following the discovery of oil in the territorial waters of Agnolia in 1953, he ordered the building of a massive fleet of oil tankers and drilling ships, while also increasing the investments on the Agnolian Navy. His quick expansion of the navy and the increased Agnolian presence in the Markian Sea has further deteriorated the country’s relations with Valgsland.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Maartin Van Hoorten

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Patricio Alvarez (born 1902) is a Lespian politician and business magnate who currently serves as the Prime Minister of the Republic of Lespia. In 1950, Eras Magazine ranked him as the 100th richest person in the world.

Alvarez began his business career in construction through his company, Alvarez Industries. In the late 1930s, he oversaw major urban development projects, including the landmark Alvarez Towers and the Falenco Five, a large-scale residential complex consisting of 5,000 apartment units in the city of Falenco.

In 1940, Patricio Alvarez was investigated by the Lespian Anti-Corruption Force for profiteering, but the case was dropped that same year following his entry into politics as a member of the Democrazia Lespia party. He would later admit that part of his decision to pursue public office was to shield himself from legal prosecution. 

Over the course of the early to mid-1940s, Alvarez emerged as a prominent voice within the party, working closely with his political mentor, Serdin Alvarro, the former party leader. Together, they laid the ideological foundation for what would later be called Lespian Protectionism, an economic strategy centered on capital safeguards, reduced foreign dependency, and support for domestic industries. Though still in opposition to the ruling Partido Libertà Nazionale, their proposals gained traction in business circles and media hubs, particularly in Ventrie City, amid growing anxieties over global capital instability. 

By the late 1940s, Alvarez had consolidated control over Democrazia Lespia and launched a sweeping national campaign ahead of the 1948 elections, leveraging his expansive business ties and media network. Following his electoral victory, he was inaugurated in early 1949 and moved quickly to establish the Lespian Capital Protection Agency in cooperation with the influential Magical Eight corporate bloc. Although Prime Minister Cauren Fidalco and the Partido Libertà Nazionale publicly condemned the direction of Alvarez's reforms, they were ultimately unable to halt the transformation of Lespia’s economic model.

As Prime Minister, Alvarez implemented sweeping tax reductions, scaled back state regulations, and introduced targeted protectionist measures to preserve national wealth and production. In foreign affairs, he secured Lespia’s membership in the Arcasian Treaty Organization, presenting the country as a distinctive economic voice within the pro-capital integration bloc while maintaining domestic economic sovereignty.

He was re-elected in 1953 and remains a central figure in Lespian politics.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Patricio Alvarez

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Romus Toras was born in 1905 in the Kingdom of Rizia, Valenqiris. He is the only child of the late king Valero "The Frail" Toras and Queen Mother Estela Toras, and holds the title of King of Rizia as well as the symbolic title of Duke of Valenqiris. 

Following the death of Queen Lyza in 1918, his father Valero ascended to the throne, a period marked by political uncertainty and rumors of unrest. Romus received his education in Porte Drazon, where he was largely isolated from commoner life.

Shortly after the prince's coming of age, Rizia entered into a conflict with the newly independent Grand Duchy of Pales that eventually escalated into a nationwide crisis, culminating in Romus's capture by insurgents led by Lucas Sazon, Duke of Brenas. His subsequent rescue by Wehzek forces marked a critical juncture in Rizian politics. The aftermath of the revolt saw significant changes, including the leasing of Zille to Wehlen and the execution of Lucas Sazon, with Romus assuming governance of Valenqiris.

Romus' tenure as Duke was marked by significant events including his strategic marriage to Lena Livingston, sister of Queen Beatrice of Rumburg. Following his wife's death in a tragic sailing accident in 1942, he became the sole guardian of their child, Princess Vina Toras.

Romus' ascension to the throne followed the death of his father in 1949, marking the beginning of his reign as King of Rizia.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Romus Toras

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Wiktor Smolak is a prominent Wehzek politician and the current President of Wehlen. In addition to his presidential duties, he serves as the commander-in-chief of the Wehzek Armed Forces. Smolak is renowned for his staunch advocacy of 'Wehzek nationalism with socialist characteristics.'

He is the third president of the Republic of Wehlen and has been a pivotal figure in local politics following the departure of Arcasian troops in 1936, which occurred in the aftermath of the Wehlen Civil War. Smolak initially rose to prominence as the leader of the National Nurist Alliance of Wehlen until 1930, a movement that fervently promoted Wehzek nationalism intertwined with Nurist traditionalism.

Dissatisfied with the previous administrations' inability to free Wehlen from the war, Smolak founded the Wehzek Nationalist Party of Nurist Socialism in 1932. This new political entity amalgamated religious Nurist beliefs with Wehzek nationalism and socialism. After surviving a decade filled with political battles, Smolak finally secured the presidency in 1943.

During his early presidency, Smolak implemented severe measures against his political opponents, enacted strict censorship of the Wehzek press, and confiscated the assets of multimillionaires. A vocal critic of Arcasia, he blamed the royalists, liberals, and democrats for the civil war and the subsequent Arcasian involvement. Although previously an opponent of Malenyevist ideologies, Smolak shifted his stance post-war and sought to align Wehlen more closely with United Contana. This alliance proved beneficial, as it facilitated significant financial aid from the CSP, helping to ameliorate the nation's economic woes.

Smolak's vigorous promotion of Wehlen nationalism and adherence to Nurist doctrine also led to the oppression of ethnic and religious minorities within the country. His rule has been marked by the widespread persecution of the Bludish people, including thousands of arrests and deaths, alongside military campaigns against the Bludish Freedom Front, which established bases in northeastern Wehlen.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Wiktor Smolak

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Artor Sanaco Wisci was a Sordish revolutionary, author, politician and the founder of the Republic of Sordland, who served as the first President of Sordland from 1923 to 1927. His brief leadership modernized Sordland into a secular, democratic republic. He was imprisoned by General Luderin after the military coup in 1927 and died tragically in prison when the building was set on fire during the Civil War in 1928.

Artor S. Wisci came from a wealthy family of the bourgeoisie and completed his education in Lespia. He authored countless books that circulated all around Sordland which were heavily inspired by the foreign writers of the Century of Revolutions, becoming an influential revolutionary figure in the country.

He served as a member of the King’s Parliament as part of the Republican faction. In 1920, he led the Republicans and advocated for the King to step down, which led to the King’s oppression of the Republican faction and tightening his control on the parliament which already acted purely as an advisory body. In the following years, Artor travelled from town to town and gathered the public support for a full on revolution in Sordland.

In 1923, he marched with a hundred thousand revolutionaries into Holsord and was greeted by the 1st Army that joined in with their march. In a matter of hours, the king abdicated the throne and Artor declared the end of the monarchy. Together with the members of the Republican faction, he wrote a new constitution and proclaimed the Republic of Sordland in 1923, marking the end of the Century of Revolutions.

Following the rising influence of the communists ahead of the first elections, General Luderin led a military coup against Artor Wisci’s government and ordered his arrest, blaming him for bringing foreign ideologies into Sordland. He was stripped of his position and remained in prison until his death in 1928, when a fire broke out in Holsord Prison, during heavy fighting in the neighbouring streets. Many still claim this to be a planned attack.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Artor Sanaco Wisci

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Ewald Alphonso is a statesman, businessman and politician, who served as the third President of Sordland from 1949 to 1953. He was the leader of the United Sordland Party from 1946 to 1953. He is particularly famed for winning against Tarquin Soll in the ‘46 Congress, bringing an end to Soll’s domination of the USP.

After studying civil engineering at Kingshill University, he briefly worked in the state department for oil and gas planning in 1924. He later undertook postgraduate studies on energy planning and management in Arcasia between 1927 and 1929. He returned to Sordland after the end of the Sordish Civil War and started working for the Gasom Corporation. He bought a large portion of the shares of the company after Contanan partners pulled out, and was later elected as its CEO.

During the construction of the Soll Dam, he worked as a project advisor and in 1935 was appointed Head of the Department of Energy, under the Ministry of Economy. He joined the USP in 1940 and was elected to the executive committee of the USP in 1941. He stepped away from his active role as CEO in 1945 and became the chairman of the board after appointing a new CEO to direct the operations of Gasom.

Alphonso gained a huge following in a very short time after his campaigns for free market reforms, and in 1946 ran as a candidate for party leadership against Tarquin Soll. He won the ‘46 congress and became the chairman of the USP. President Soll appointed him as Vice President and he came the de-facto government leader as the President stepped back from politics. He later ran as a presidential candidate in the general elections of 1949 and was elected president. He was supported by influential figures like Kris Schar, Konrath Koronti and Walter Tusk, which are believed to have played a great role in his election as president.

His term saw many market reforms that were implemented very quickly in his first year. He privatized several industries, brought tax cuts, relaxed immigration policies and changed several of Tarquin Soll’s authoritarian laws to bring foreign investment to Sordland. However, he was faced with the economic recession of 1951, which quickly proved to be the worst economic crisis in Sordland since the Sordish Civil War. Some claim the ineffectiveness of his economic reforms were the result of a conspiracy by the Old Guard.

In 1953, his cabinet resigned after his inability to control the economic crisis. He resigned from politics after losing the party congress against Anton Rayne. Upon his departure from politics, Alphonso channeled his leadership and resources into his role as chairman at Gasom and towards philanthropic efforts, establishing the Alphonso Foundation.

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Tarquin Soll (Colonel Soll) is a military officer and politician, who served as the 2nd President of Sordland between 1929 and 1949. He is regarded by some Sollists as the founder of the Republic of Sordland since the first years of the republic between 1923 and 1927 were short lived due to the Civil War. Soll assumed the post in 1929 by ending the Sordish Civil War and taking control of the government under military rule. He is the founder of the United Sordland Party. He is regarded as the most significant and controversial person in Sordland’s history.

Tarquin was a colonel and the commander of the 6th army of the Sordish Armed Forces when General Luderin executed a military coup in 1927, which he did not join. Later in 1927, Civil War broke out between armies of the Sordish military as well as militant political organizations. Following this, Tarquin Soll and the 6th Army joined the war and managed to win several major battles against both General Luderin and General Rikard. In January 1929, the 6th army took control of Holsord and started pushing the rebels to the east. Later in the year, Tarquin Soll put an end to the Sordish Civil War, took control of the government, wrote a new Constitution, and called the Grand National Assembly back to work. He formed the USP and went to elections with one party and became the President of Sordland.

His first years saw many developments in Sordland, restoring and surpassing the pre-Civil War production levels. He invested heavily into infrastructure, healthcare and police forces. Many forgotten areas of Sordland were provided with services for the first time in their history during Soll administration. He also addressed the much problematic energy problem of Sordland with the Soll Dam project in Erzaren which triggered the 1933 Izzam Incident and a long conflict with Bludish separatists.

After his first term as President, Tarquin called for elections in 1933 and ran as a candidate in the first ever elections of Sordland with multiple parties, which still resulted in a massive win for Tarquin Soll and the USP. In total he won five elections and served as President of Sordland for twenty years.

His later terms saw further economic developments along with an increase in political and racial tensions in Sordland. Many Bludish activists and politicians were arrested, communists were detained for suspected crimes against the state. The media was under his control and censored the opposing voices. Many different political parties entered politics to oppose Tarquin Soll’s leadership, and several of them were closed down.

In the 1940’s, the opposition against Tarquin Soll reached new heights, triggering major protests against him within the USP. In the late 1940’s, the new reformist wing in the party saw a great increase in its influence and started to challenge Tarquin. In 1946, he lost the leadership vote to Ewald Alphonso and resigned as the chairman of the USP. He went on to serve as President of Sordland until 1949.

After his resignation as president, he moved to reside in Duru Island at the mouth of the Gulf of Nargis. He is currently the only person who holds the title “Member of Honor”, which gives him total immunity as well as an indefinite right to partake in the Grand National Assembly of Sordland.

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Alfred Kcirbuk is a Sordish film director, producer and screenwriter. He is one of the most influential Sordish directors of the decade, and the only Sordish director to ever be nominated for the prestigious Motion Picture Awards in Arcasia.

While in his twenties, Kcirbuk directed a number of stage productions for the state theaters, including an adaptation of the famous ‘Unger’ with an entirely Bludish cast. His first film was ‘Resident Karl,’ a controversial movie with socio political commentary on Sordland, which is consistently ranked the greatest Sordish film ever made. It was later banned in Sordland by Tarquin Soll in 1940.

By 1945, Kcirbuk was a filmmaker of international importance, with several of his films being screened in various other countries. He wrote and directed famous movies such as ‘Rebeka’, ‘A Touch of Satan’ and ‘Eyes Wide Open.’

In 1953, his film ‘The Sordish Dream’ was nominated for the best foreign film in the Arcasian Motion Picture Awards.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Alfred Kcirbuk

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Dewlen Arge is a Bludish political leader, a founding member of the militant Bludish Freedom Front (BFF), who has been a political prisoner since his arrest in 1944. He used to be the leader of the BFF between 1935 and 1944. He is being held in the Antel Rock Prison.

According to some sources, Arge was born in a border village between Wehlen and Sordland. During his youth, he was a member of the Republican Youth and supported the revolution against the monarchy in the Kingdom of Sordland. After the fall of the monarchy, he joined the youth wing of the Bludish Freedom Party (BFP) to promote the improvement of the Bludish rights.

After the cancellation of the first ever elections in Sordland by General Luderin and the subsequent civil war in 1927, he wanted to fight against the military coup by joining the Sordish Armed Forces under the leadership of General Rikard, but was denied entry due to his ethnicity. This prompted him to return to Bergia to organize the Bludish populace to also join the civil war with their own militia army, but couldn’t gather a large support.

After the war, he started working in Erzaren as a simple merchant and serving in the local council of the Bludish Freedom Party. When he learned about the plans of the Soll Dam in 1933, he participated in the protests against the construction with other members of the BFP and experienced the Izzam Incident first-hand. After the death of Aschraf and the ban on the BFP, he fled to the village of Zensehir, and along with a group of students, formed an organization called ‘The Followers of Aschraf.’ They later changed their name to Bludish Freedom Front.

In 1935, Arge took control of the BFF and announced a full-scale Bludish uprising in the region of Bergia. He gained great infamy when his forces took control of Uziren and defended the town against the Sordish Armed Forces for two weeks. Between 1935 and 1944, he was behind many armed attacks against the Sordish military, Sordish police as well as civilians. He was finally arrested in 1944 and was imprisoned in Antel Rock Prison.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Dewlen Arge

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Dewlen Arge is a Bludish political leader, a founding member of the militant Bludish Freedom Front (BFF), who was a political prisoner between 1944 and 1957. He used to be the leader of the BFF between 1935 and 1944. He was released from Antel Rock Prison by President Rayne’s controversial amnesty decree in 1957.

According to some sources, Arge was born in a border village between Wehlen and Sordland. During his youth, he was a member of the Republican Youth and supported the revolution against the monarchy in the Kingdom of Sordland. After the fall of the monarchy, he joined the youth wing of the Bludish Freedom Party (BFP) to promote the improvement of the Bludish rights.

After the cancellation of the first ever elections in Sordland by General Luderin and the subsequent civil war in 1927, he wanted to fight against the military coup by joining the Sordish Armed Forces under the leadership of General Rikard, but was denied entry due to his ethnicity. This prompted him to return to Bergia to organize the Bludish populace to also join the civil war with their own militia army, but couldn’t gather a large support.

After the war, he started working in Erzaren as a simple merchant and serving in the local council of the Bludish Freedom Party. When he learned about the plans of the Soll Dam in 1933, he participated in the protests against the construction with other members of the BFP and experienced the Izzam Incident first-hand. After the death of Aschraf and the ban on the BFP, he fled to the village of Zensehir, and along with a group of students, formed an organization called ‘The Followers of Aschraf.’ They later changed their name to Bludish Freedom Front.

In 1935, Arge took control of the BFF and announced a full-scale Bludish uprising in the region of Bergia. He gained great infamy when his forces took control of Uziren and defended the town against the Sordish Armed Forces for two weeks. Between 1935 and 1944, he was behind many armed attacks against the Sordish military, Sordish police as well as civilians. He was finally arrested in 1944 and was imprisoned in Antel Rock Prison.

Following the Bludish Freedom Front’s attacks in 1957, President Rayne agreed to the demands of the group to free Arge from Antel Rock Prison.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Dewlen Arge

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
President Ephraim Nines is an economist and former diplomat who serves as the President of the Alliance of Nations. 

Born into poverty in Konstantium, Kyrute, President Nines struggled with literacy during his early education. Despite these obstacles, his aptitude for numbers stood out, and he eventually taught himself to read. It was only later in life that he discovered his struggles stemmed from undiagnosed dyslexia.

Nines graduated from the prestigious Konstantium University with a degree in Economics and International Relations, a rigorous hybrid program blending economics, political science, and international affairs. His academic achievements paved the way for his first major role as an Economic Development Specialist at the International Economic Development Authority (IEDA). The organization's mission is to foster global economic stability and support sustainable growth in developing nations.

Demonstrating exceptional skill and leadership, Nines rapidly rose through the agency ranks, ultimately becoming its director by age 35.

In 1937, the Kyrute government appointed Nines to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, where he served in various diplomatic roles. By 1941, he was selected as Kyrute's Permanent Representative to the Alliance of Nations, gaining invaluable experience in peacekeeping and international cooperation. His efforts culminated in his election as President of the Alliance of Nations in 1948.

President Nines is known for bringing a quiet but firm hand to diplomacy.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Ephraim Nines

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Evelyn Vectern is a Sordish journalist, author and school teacher who is the wife of Petr Vectern, the current Vice President of Sordland. In 1953, to help support her husband in his political career, she ended her career as a teacher of literature at the prestigious Holsord State High School.

After graduating from the Holsord State University, Vectern started working as an editor in the magazine, Kosmopolit. She married Petr Vectern in 1936.

Vectern later joined the Holsord Post as a journalist where she became known for her pro-government articles throughout the late 1940’s. Simultaneously, she started working as a teacher of literature at the Holsord State High school.

She was expelled from the newspaper after defending Ewald Alphonso and writing about a ‘conspiracy by the state apparatus’. In 1953, she quit her job to support Petr Vectern’s candidacy as the running mate of Anton Rayne.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Evelyn Vectern

CodexEntryProperties.Description:

CodexEntryProperties.Title: Evelyn Vectern

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
General Eduard Luderin was a Sordish military officer who led the military coup of 1927 and fought in the Sordish Civil War. In 1929, the Supreme Court ruled for his execution for leading the military coup in 1927, obstructing democracy by deposing the President Artor S. Wisci, and abolishing the constitution.

Eduard Luderin served as army chief in the King’s Army before the revolution. Later on, he served as general in the Sordish Armed Forces. In 1927, following the left-wing riots in Sordland, Luderin took control of the 3rd and 4th Armies and led a military coup ahead of the first elections, suspending the Constitution and declaring martial law. He imprisoned President Artor Wisci and blamed the revolution for making Sordland a puppet for foreign powers. Later on, he ordered the execution of hundreds of communists. He promoted nationalist organizations and established the Young Sords to promote Sordish nationalism among the youth.

Following the bloody incidents of his martial law, the public started to engage in armed conflicts with the military which was followed by General Rikard’s intervention. This led to the bloody Sordish Civil War of 1928, which lasted until 1929 when Colonel Tarquin Soll took control of Holsord and declared the war to be over.

Eduard Luderin was later found guilty of crimes against the Sordish state and was executed in 1929.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: General Luderin

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
General Iannick Rikard was a Sordish military officer who led the 7th Army in the Sordish Civil War. In 1929, he was killed in action during the Battle of Holsord while fighting against the forces of Colonel Tarquin Soll.

Iannick Rikard was a general of the Sordish Armed Forces in 1927 when General Luderin led his military coup. He stayed out of conflict until the execution of hundreds of communists and left-wing activists by the orders of General Luderin in 1928, which triggered the Sordish Civil War. He attacked Holsord with the 7th Army, capturing and holding it for seven months. He supported the Red Youth with equipment to continue their fighting in the cities.

In 1929, he was shot dead during the Battle of Holsord, which resulted in the victory of Colonel Tarquin Soll’s 6th Army, marking the end of the Civil War.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: General Rikard

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Giralt Haute-Bellasorde, or more commonly known as Giralt of Ribery, was a pioneering Sordish viticulturist and winemaker of Lespian descent, who was the first to cultivate the famous Borin grape. He is known as ‘the father of Sordish viticulture.’

Giralt of Ribery is credited with introducing important innovations to Sordish winemaking. He was born in Ribery. He began producing wine under his own label, Dandelion, in the 1910s. He was particularly known for the quality of his wines which used grapes from Borin and Erlory.

Dandelion wines are now highly sought after and renowned for their floral tones and elegance, as well as their lushness and concentration.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Giralt of Ribery

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Herman Equa is a Sordish political scientist, historian, and writer. He is a retired professor of political sciences from Holsord State University. Equa was born in 1880 in Conriat, to a family of soldiers. Equa is the first Sordish national to have been awarded the prestigious Vulpitzer Award, a distinction later also achieved by Bernard Circas, who became the second ever recipient from Sordland.

Equa pursued his strong interest in political sciences after completing his studies and becoming a professor. He garnered the respect of opposite and like-minded academicians after publishing dozens of research papers. One of his most notable works is the 'Geopolitics of Sordland' and 'Post-Revolution Synthesis'. The renowned books he wrote took the intelligentsia of the country by storm and began influencing many political decisions of the first Sordish government under Tarquin Soll.

After much prominence and discourse in front of the academic eye, he stepped away from public life following a period of sickness. Currently, he resides in Conriat in his family estate.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Herman Equa

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Ishval Ersen is a distinguished Bludish lawyer and civil rights activist who's based in Deyr, Sordland. Born in 1909 in Uziren, Ersen completed his legal education at Deyr University of Culture in 1932 and has since dedicated his career to addressing civil rights issues in Bergia and wider Sordland, advocating for the Bludish community.

Throughout his career, he has been unyielding in the face of adversity, including an eviction from his home under dubious charges of 'threatening public stability and safety.' Beyond his courtroom work, Ersen has engaged in political and social debates. Notably, he has critiqued certain government policies like the controversial Resettlement Order, voicing concerns over potential infringement on the rights of the Bludish people.

Ersen has also questioned the coherence of Sordland's Constitution, suggesting a possible conflict between Articles 6 and 7 and the rights defined in Article 100. The case he filed against Governor Bron rocketed him to nationwide fame.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Ishval Ersen

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Johan Gasmich is a Sordish communist revolutionary of Agno-Sordish descent, activist and the founder and leader of the Red Youth.

Gasmich studied in Arvory State School and later at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering of Lachaven Technical University. He initially supported President Artor Wisci and his national democratic movement, but later changed his view. After reading about Marcian socio-economics, he translated Karlos Marcia’s biography into Sordish.

Inspired by Marcian Socio-economics, Malenyevism and Valgslandian socialism, he founded and led the Socialist Students Association of Lachaven Technical University. In 1927, Gasmich founded the Red Youth and joined the armed resistance against General Luderin’s military takeover.

He admired the guerilla fighters in Rika who fought against colonisation and created a strategy of armed guerilla warfare to achieve what he called the people’s revolution. He is suspected to be the person who devised the plan to assassinate General Luderin in 1928 with a group of Red Youth revolutionaries. The attempt failed when Luderin’s soldiers confronted the group and all the activists were killed. He is suspected to be within the group, but managed to escape.

After the Sordish Civil War, Gasmich began his editorial career as the editor-in-chief for the Tussle magazine where he worked together with Denis Stahler. He continued his political life in the struggle for the unification of Sordland's socialist movement.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Johan Gasmich

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Johan Gasmich is a Sordish communist revolutionary of Agno-Sordish descent, activist, the founder and the former leader of the Red Youth. He was arrested after the ban on the Red Youth and is currently being held in Antel Rock Prison.

Gasmich studied in Arvory State School and later at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering of Lachaven Technical University. He initially supported President Artor Wisci and his national democratic movement, but later changed his view.
