The attempt failed when Luderin’s soldiers confronted the group and all the activists were killed. He is suspected to be within the group, but managed to escape.

After the Sordish Civil War, Gasmich began his editorial career as the editor-in-chief for the Tussle magazine where he worked together with Denis Stahler. He continued his political life in the struggle for the unification of Sordland's socialist movement.

Following the ban on the Red Youth in 1954, he was arrested and imprisoned in Antel Rock Prison.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Johan Gasmich

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Livia Suno is the private secretary of President Anton Rayne. She is tasked with directly handling most of the critical calls, scheduling and paperwork for the president.

Suno had previously worked at the Sordish Airlines headquarters as the secretary of the director, before starting her work for the United Sordland Party National Committee in 1953, where she was assigned to assist Petr Vectern, who was organizing support for presidential nominee Anton Rayne.

After Rayne’s successful election, Suno began serving as the personal secretary in Rayne’s office at the Maroon Palace.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Livia Suno

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Ilana Vance was a Rumburgian spy who briefly served as the private secretary of President Anton Rayne under the alias “Livia Suno.” During her service in Sordland, she was tasked with directly handling most of the critical calls, scheduling and paperwork for the president.

Vance had previously worked at the Sordish Airlines headquarters as the secretary of the director, before starting her work for the United Sordland Party National Committee in 1953, where she was assigned to assist Petr Vectern, who was organizing support for presidential nominee Anton Rayne.

After Rayne’s successful election, Vance began serving as the personal secretary in Rayne’s office at the Maroon Palace. She served as President Rayne’s secretary until 1956 when she was arrested after her identity was uncovered by a state investigation. She is being held in Antel Rock Prison.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Livia Suno

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Livia Suno is the former private secretary of President Anton Rayne. She was tasked with directly handling most of the critical calls, scheduling and paperwork for the president. She was dismissed from her position in 1956.

Suno had previously worked at the Sordish Airlines headquarters as the secretary of the director, before starting her work for the United Sordland Party National Committee in 1953, where she was assigned to assist Petr Vectern, who was organizing support for presidential nominee Anton Rayne.

After Rayne’s successful election, Suno began serving as the personal secretary in Rayne’s office at the Maroon Palace. She served as President Rayne’s secretary until 1956.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Livia Suno

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Livia Suno was the private secretary of President Anton Rayne. She was tasked with directly handling most of the critical calls, scheduling and paperwork for the president. She was reported missing in 1956.

Suno had previously worked at the Sordish Airlines headquarters as the secretary of the director, before starting her work for the United Sordland Party National Committee in 1953, where she was assigned to assist Petr Vectern, who was organizing support for presidential nominee Anton Rayne.

After Rayne’s successful election, Suno began serving as the personal secretary in Rayne’s office at the Maroon Palace. She served as President Rayne’s secretary until 1956 when she was reported to be missing. The investigations regarding her disappearance have never been concluded.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Livia Suno

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Serge Wolkner is a Sordish driver who serves as the presidential driver of President Anton Rayne.

Born in the small town of Nehir, between Erzaren and Deyr, Wolkner attended the Deyr Dastnurity School. He then attended Holsord State University. After his graduation, he had to leave the capital due to lack of jobs at the time, and briefly worked as a truck driver between the cities of Anrica and Lachaven. He later entered the Sordish Police Academy, but despite completing his training, he did not join the police forces. He briefly worked as a private bodyguard in Holsord before entering the special training course of the Maroon Palace.

After completing his extensive training of protective driving, firearms and first-aid, he joined the service of the Maroon Palace as a driver in 1930. He was tasked with driving various guests of the state, as well as transporting certain documents and goods to the Maroon Palace.

He was chosen to be the presidential driver in 1954 after the departure of Nouman Fevon who was the driver of both President Soll and Alphonso. Serge is the most experienced driver in the service of the Maroon Palace, having served for over twenty years.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Serge Wolkner

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Serge Wolkner was a Sordish driver who had served as the presidential driver of President Anton Rayne until his death in 1957.

Born in the small town of Nehir, between Erzaren and Deyr, Wolkner attended the Deyr Dastnurity School. He then attended Holsord State University. After his graduation, he had to leave the capital due to lack of jobs at the time, and briefly worked as a truck driver between the cities of Anrica and Lachaven. He later entered the Sordish Police Academy, but despite completing his training, he did not join the police forces. He briefly worked as a private bodyguard in Holsord before entering the special training course of the Maroon Palace.

After completing his extensive training of protective driving, firearms and first-aid, he joined the service of the Maroon Palace as a driver in 1930. He was tasked with driving various guests of the state, as well as transporting certain documents and goods to the Maroon Palace.

He was chosen to be the presidential driver in 1954 after the departure of Nouman Fevon who was the driver of both President Soll and Alphonso. Serge was the most experienced driver in the service of the Maroon Palace, having served for over twenty years.

During a military parade in 1957, he was killed by assassins who attempted to kill President Rayne. Today, he is regarded as a national hero who saved Anton Rayne by taking the bullet.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Serge Wolkner

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Tuomas Sacker, born 1912, is a Kyrutean journalist and television interviewer known for his work in both print and broadcast media. He began his career at the Konstantium Defender, where he rose to become a senior journalist and managing editor. Sacker studied political science and journalism at the University of Konstantium and gained early recognition for investigative reporting and his political contacts within Kyrute’s diplomatic and media circles. 

Sacker later transitioned into television broadcasting after finding affluent financiers from the Heart of Konstantium and became the host of the interview program One-on-One, which features discussions with heads of state and other prominent political figures across the globe. Over time, a professional rivalry emerged between Sacker’s program and Geopolitico's own show.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Tuomas Sacker

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Watani Aschraf was a Bludish carpenter who was killed by Sordish soldiers during his protest against the construction of the Soll Dam. His death and the subsequent chaos that escalated between the protesters and the Sordish soldiers came to be known as the Izzam Incident. He became a symbol of the Bludish resistance movement in Sordland.

Not much is known about Aschraf other than his work as a carpenter in the village of Izzam near Erzaren. According to many sources, he was respected as the village’s elder and many villagers seeked his advice. In 1933, when Sordish authorities came to the village to force the villagers out of their homes, he refused to leave his home. He took part in the protests against Soll Dam, which threatened to destroy Izzam by leaving it under water.

He was shot and killed by a soldier on the tenth day of the protests. Following his death, his name became a symbol of Bludish rights. His death is mourned by the Bludish democrats and the Bludish separatists alike. The Bludish Freedom Front was initially called ‘The Followers of Aschraf.’
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Watani Aschraf

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Denis Stahler is a Sordish political theorist and politician who serves as the current leader of the Communist Party of Sordland (CPS.) Originally starting politics in the first Communist Party with the same name that existed between 1924 and 1928, he later joined People’s Freedom and Justice Party (PFJP,) and in 1950, co-founded the second Communist Party of Sordland in 1950.

Stahler became an exponent of communist ideas during his studies in the University of Haelm in Valgsland. After earning his doctorate in political economy, he moved to Holsord in 1927, where he hoped to open a lawyer’s office. He joined the Communist Party (1924-1928) and faced prosecution under General Luderin after the ban on the Communist Party in 1928. Fearing the complete annihilation of Sordish socialists by the junta, he moved to Valgsland and assisted the Red Youth by establishing connections between the Sordish and Valgslandian socialists with the help of the governing People’s Party of Valgsland.

After the civil war, he worked as a lawyer in Holsord, often defending other left-wing socialists. He was involved with smuggling Malenyevist propaganda from United Contana to Sordland as well as writing and publishing his own socialist magazine, ‘Tussle.’ He wrote extensively against militarism and authoritarianism. Because of his political theories on communism and physical resemblance to Emmerich Hegel, he was given the nickname ‘Sordish Hegel’ by his admirers.

Despite being regarded as a Malenyevist in Sordland, he wrote articles criticizing some of Leon Malenyev’s policies, arguing that Malenyevism was distorting the real ideals of Marcian socio-economics. He also heavily protested against the United Contanan Navy’s presence in Eastern Merkopa. He joined the PFJP as a social democrat in 1936 with hopes to enter the Grand National Assembly of Sordland, but he was denied top positions in the candidate lists due to his communist views, and couldn’t get elected.

In 1950, Stahler co-founded the CPS with a group of other socialist politicians and political theorists. He wrote a manifesto titled ‘Sordish Socialism,’ which caused a split within the party between the followers of Stahler’s ‘Sordish socialists’ and the Malenyevists. He invited the famous poet Bernard Circas to join the party ahead of their first elections in 1953, but was rejected.

In the ‘53 elections, he got just below 8% of the general vote, failing to pass the election threshold. After the election of President Rayne, he doubled his efforts to increase his party’s reach by opening new offices in every major city in Sordland.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Denis Stahler

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Fetih Ejall is a Sordish writer and politician of Bludish descent, ex-member of the first Communist Party, and the current leader of the pro-Bludish Workers Party of Bludia. He is a strong supporter of socialism and an advocate for the rights of the Bludish minority.

During his education in Deyr University of Culture in 1925, he entered politics by joining the youth wing of the Communist Party which existed between 1924 and 1928. In 1927, when General Luderin organized a military coup and ordered the execution of the communists, he fled from Sordland on a cargo ship. He briefly lived in Valgsland and Wehlen before returning to Sordland in 1929.

On his return, he found out that the Communist Party was closed down and most of its members arrested. Between 1929 and 1940, he wrote and published many books, and became the editor of a series of satirical periodicals for a socialist magazine. He was jailed several times and placed under surveillance by the Sordish Intelligence Directorate for his political views.

Ejall provided a strong indictment of the oppression of the common people and the minorities in his publications. He satirized Sordish bureaucracy and Sollism, while campaigning for the improvement of Bludish rights. Ejall has been presented with numerous awards in Sordland, Valgsland and United Contana for his works. He is regarded to be one of the most influential Sordish socialists along with Bernard Circas.

In 1948, he came together with a group of Bludish politicians and founded the Workers Party of Bludia. After the resignation of Mansoun Leke as chairman, he was elected as the party’s next leader. In the ‘53 elections, he got 9% of the general vote, failing to pass the election threshold.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Fetih Ejall

Frens Ricter is a Sordish politician, businessman and the leader of the People’s Freedom and Justice Party. He is also the major shareholder of the construction company, Taurus Holding.

Before his political career, he studied economics at Lachaven Business School and worked for the Watchtower of Human Rights in Arcasia. After his return to Sordland in 1924, he formed a company that imported machine parts from Arcasia and made several investments into service and industrial companies. He helped open research and development departments in these companies and promoted innovation in Taurus Holding after he acquired its majority shares.

He was also known as a notable human rights advocate in Sordland before he joined PFJP in 1932. He was famed due to his strong opposition against Tarquin Soll after his military coup, and was elected as the leader of PFJP in 1949. He promoted economic liberalism throughout his first years.

During the 1930’s, Frens supported the opposition against the majority government of the USP with little gains. He was a strong critic of Tarquin Soll’s policies, labeling Soll as a “dictator,” which led to a state investigation on him. He started advocating social democracy and campaigning for reforming the democracy of Sordland in the 1940’s, which led to a huge rise in PFJP votes. In 1949, he won 30% of the vote, barely losing the elections, which also contributed to a crisis within the governing party. He is sometimes credited as the real winner of the ‘49 elections, which was followed by the resignation of Tarquin Soll in the same year and a strong change within the USP.

After the election of Ewald Alphonso, Frens kept his stance against the government and once infamously called him a “puppet of the deep state,” criticizing him for not upholding his promises for change. Although he was a strong opponent, he supported his privatization policies.

Frens Ricter remains as the leader of the opposition against the government in Sordland. He has been gaining more popularity over the last years and organized countless public speeches, explaining the importance of democratic values and his plans for reform.

Kesaro Kibener is a Sordish politician and the leader of the National Front Party. He has been a member of the assembly since 1941. He represents the far-right of the Sordish politics. Despite his views, he is respected by nationalists on both sides of the political spectrum.

Before his political career, he was enrolled into a military school and graduated from Holsord State University with an Arts degree. After briefly pursuing a career as a propaganda artist, he joined the Sordish Armed Forces in 1925. Although not verified by the state or himself, he was rumoured to be the private who announced General Luderin’s ‘27 military coup against the government of President Artor Wisci on radio broadcast, which earned him great fame among the populace.

In 1931, he founded the National Front party together with a group of nationalists from Jen. During the 1930s, he took on a strong stance against immigration during the Wehlen Civil War and was blamed by a significant part of the populace for inciting violence in the city streets against Agno-Sordish and Bludish people. He organized countless meetings, panels and helped form nationalist student organizations in the top universities in Sordland. He had given notable support to the Young Sords organization from its founding to its expansion in the following years.

In 1936, he was elected as the mayor of Jen, becoming the first mayor elected from the NFP. After serving as mayor until 1940, he was elected as a member of the assembly in 1941. After the elections of 1949, Kesaro was elected as the leader of the National Front and announced his bid for presidency. In 1949, Kesaro survived an assassination attempt which boosted his popularity more than ever. He claimed the assassin was a Bludish separatist who 'wanted to erase Sordish identity.'

In the ‘53 elections, he managed to get the best results of NFP in its history, effectively becoming the third largest party in Sordland and the assembly.

Curtan Leste is a Sordish politician and a member of the United Sordland Party, who has been serving as the mayor of Anrica since 1940. He previously served as the mayor of Benfi from 1936 to 1940. He is the longest serving mayor in the country.

Born in Anrica, Leste’s family moved to Benfi for his father’s career as a lawyer. Having his primary and secondary education in Benfi, he later moved to the capital to attend the Holsord State University. After his studies, he worked as a correspondent for the Holsord Post newspaper. He also founded the National Nurists Association to fight against the ‘decreasing religious and moral values among the youth.’

In 1930, he returned to Benfi to start his own business. He managed a small seaside hotel and a restaurant before joining the United Sordland Party. He started his political career when he ran as a mayor for the district of Almonds in Benfi and got elected.

In 1936, he was elected mayor of Benfi. He organized the famous Benfi Culture Festival as part of the Day of Descension festivities, which brought millions of Nurist tourists to the city over the years.

After the sudden death of the mayor of Anrica, Leste was appointed by Tarquin Soll as the new mayor in 1940. During his tenure as the mayor of Anrica, he promoted the city’s cultural heritage sites, invested in renovating old Sordish monuments and increased tourism greatly. His term saw the city expand greatly in size and become the logistical center of the Greater Holsord region.

He was later re-elected three times in a row, becoming the longest serving mayor in the history of Sordland. Over the years, he became very popular among the Sordish nationalists and the conservatives for his public speeches and accomplishments as mayor. He is considered to be the most well-known mayor in all of Sordland, as well as one of the most popular figures in the United Sordland Party.

Didier Meye is a Sordish jurist and academician who serves as the dean of the Faculty of Law at Holsord State University.

He graduated from Morna University Faculty of Law and received his PhD from the University of Perla, in Lespia. He later became a judge in the Holsord Court of Civil Appeals in 1940.

Meye returned to his academic career in 1949 as a professor of law, and later was appointed as the dean of the Faculty of Law in Holsord State University.

During his service in the Holsord State University, Meye became famous for his conservative practices. Despite his close ties to the United Sordland Party and the Soll administration, he wasn’t appointed to the High Court of Appeals which he allegedly has asked for numerous times.

Edith Agnoc is a Sordish economist and banker who serves as the Chairwoman of the Central Bank of Sordland. She is the first woman to hold that position. She also became the first woman to serve as a president of a bank in the world.

Agnoc is known in Sordland as the adopted daughter of the first president of the republic, Artor S. Wisci. According to official sources, Wisci met her during his visit to Narbel. After learning her story, her miserable living conditions and her desire to study at a university, Wisci decided to adopt her and financed her education. She studied in Holsord State University and later finished her masters in Lachaven Business School.

After General Luderin’s military coup and Wisci’s arrest in 1927, Agnoc fled to Lespia, where she lived until 1928. She moved to Arcasia after the death of her adoptive father Wisci, and started working at one of the largest investment firms, Crain Capital in Ventrie City. She became renowned for her economic expertise in Arcasia and later quit her job to work at the renowned Global Bank.

In 1951, she was invited by Ewald Alphonso to return to Sordland to help with the economic crisis. On her return, she was appointed to be the chairwoman of the Central Bank of Sordland. She was selected as the only female economist for the cover of 'The 20 Greatest Economists in History' published by the Eras Magazine.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Edith Agnoc

Herbert Krull is a Sordish politician who has been serving as the Governor of Bergia since 1956. He is a member of the National Front Party (NFP.) Born in 1900, Krull has carved out a lengthy career in public service and he is considered to be one of the prominent members of the NFP. His role as the Deputy Governor to Phelix Bron in Bergia, a position he assumed in 1947, made him one of the most prominent and powerful nationalists in Sordland.

Throughout his tenure as Deputy Governor, Krull has demonstrated his political acumen by efficiently managing various administrative duties and often stepping in to make critical decisions during crises. Amidst widespread controversy and unrest in the region, Krull has become a key player in Bergian politics, organizing and leading anti-seperatist operations on behalf of Governor Bron. His political prowess and popularity among Sord nationalists, coupled with his commitment to "upholding the constitutional rights of all Sords", placed him in a unique position in the regional government of Bergia. His capacity to maintain stability in the midst of political turmoil has earned him the respect of his peers and constituents alike.

After the Supreme Court's decision to charge and dismiss Governor Bron for following unconstitutional policies, he was appointed as the Governor of the Special Zone of Bergia to serve until 1959, when the 6-year term of Governor Bron was supposed to end.

Ishval Ersen is a Bludish lawyer, civil rights activist and politician, who has been serving as the Governor of Bergia (Autonomous Zone) since 1957. Born in 1909 in Uziren, Ersen completed his legal education at Deyr University of Culture in 1932 and has since dedicated his career to addressing civil rights issues in Bergia and wider Sordland, advocating for the Bludish community. He played a key role in highlighting the structural problems of the Special Zone of Bergia and its subsequent abolishment.

Throughout his career, he has been unyielding in the face of adversity, including an eviction from his home under dubious charges of 'threatening public stability and safety.' Beyond his courtroom work, Ersen has engaged in political and social debates. Notably, he has critiqued certain government policies like the controversial Resettlement Order, voicing concerns over potential infringement on the rights of the Bludish people.

He has also questioned the coherence of Sordland's Constitution, suggesting a possible conflict between Articles 6 and 7 and the rights defined in Article 100. The case he filed against Governor Bron rocketed him to nationwide fame.

In 1957, after the formation of the Autonomous Zone of Bergia, he was elected to be the Governor of the region, with the role of leading the newly established Regional Assembly of Bergia.

Karl Greiser is a Sordish police officer and administrator who is the current Greater Holsord Police Chief. He assumed the position in 1950 and was sworn in by Mayor Lileas Graf in a public ceremony. Prior to his appointment to this position, he served as the Chief of Police of Arvory in the 40’s.

Karl started his career in law enforcement with his appointment to the Arvory Police Academy in late 1920. After graduating in the top 10% of his academy class, he was sworn in as a Patrolman in to serve the citizens of the Downtown Arvory.

In 1940, he was appointed Deputy Commissioner of Operations. In this capacity, he improved the department's strategies and tactics for reducing crime and solving concerns of the diverse communities of Arvory.

After 1947, he transferred to the capital and briefly served as Inspector and Chief of Detectives before his appointment as Police Chief.

Ovid Grecer is a Sordish jurist and academician who has been serving as the Deputy President of the High Court of Appeals of Sordland.

He graduated from Holsord State University and began his career as a judge in Benfi. Following his military service, he served in the Holsord District Court, later becoming a professor in Holsord State University Faculty of Law. As an academic, he became renowned for his published works in Sordland and abroad.

Grecer later served in both the Holsord Court of Criminal Appeals and Holsord Court of Civil Appeals as a judge. Because of his expertise, he was appointed as a judge in the High Court of Appeals in Holsord in 1938, and was later elected as the deputy president in 1946.

Grecer holds no membership to any political party or movement. Despite being regarded as not being fond of Sollism, he has always kept his political ideology to himself, which brought him praise for his neutrality from all sides of the political spectrum, including Sollists.

Phelix Bron is a Sordish politician who has been serving as the Governor of Bergia since 1941. He is a member of the United Sordland Party. Regarded as a hardline nationalist, he is widely unpopular among the Bludish community living in Bergia. He's known for the violent policies he followed during the fight against the Bludish Freedom Front in the 1930's and is generally credited as the person who arrested Dewlen Arge, the former leader of the BFF.

Bron was born in Anrica and after completing his studies at Holsord State University, he joined the ranks of the Kings Intelligence Service. His military career began under General Eduard Luderin. Initially a supporter of Luderin's coup and fighting on his side in the war, he shifted his allegiance to Tarquin Soll during the Battle of Holsord in the Sordish Civil War. Later, Bron transitioned to politics, joining the United Sordland Party (USP.) In 1932, he took on the role as Mayor of Deyr.

Initially a moderate on racial issues, Bron adopted a hard-line nationalist stance after the Izzam Incident and the subsequent revolt in Bergia by the Bludish Freedom Front. Bron earned national notoriety when he stood in front of the entrance of the Archsantuary of Deyr with armed policemen, blocking the path of Bludish Nurists and not allowing them to attend the Descension Day rituals in 1934.

After the formation of the Special Zone in Bergia in 1935, he was appointed as the head of the Counter-Separatism Unit in the Ministry of the Interior. When Dewlen Arge declared a rebellion in Bergia in 1935, he worked extensively with the governor on the fight against the BFF. 

In 1941, he was appointed as the Governor of the Special Zone of Bergia by President Tarquin Soll. During his tenure as governor, he promoted industrial development, increased taxes and improved regional law enforcement. He is also credited for the arrest of the BFF leader, Dewlen Arge, due to his massive budget increases of the regional police forces, and leading the operation of his capture. He was later appointed as governor again in 1947 and later in 1953 by President Ewald Alphonso, retaining his position as governor.

Valken Kruger is a Sordish four star general, the current chief of the Sordish Armed Forces and the chief of the Sordish General Staff. He previously served as the Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff of Army High Command and the 2nd Chief of Army Staff of the Sordish Army. He is the longest serving and the second most decorated officer in Sordland.

Kruger served in the Imperial Army before 1923, holding positions such as Colonel and Major. In 1927, he supported General Luderin’s military coup, but later turned against him after Luderin’s mass executions in 1928. He was among the group of officers who organized under Colonel Soll in the Sordish Civil War.

In 1929, Kruger was appointed Brigadier General and a member of the Sordish General Staff. He became famed for his military victory in 1933 along the Wehlen border, where his smaller brigade destroyed an entire rebel army in the battle of Zeharen. He was later awarded with the ‘White Star’ by Tarquin Soll, the highest medal that can be bestowed upon an individual by the Sordish Armed Forces.

Valken was one of the key supporters of Tarquin Soll during the 30’s and the 40’s. He became the Chief of the Armed Forces in 1945, becoming the oldest person to hold that title.

Heron Garaci is a jurist and politician, who is currently serving as a justice of the Supreme Court. He also served as the Minister of Justice and Law from 1945 to 1949.

Before his political career, Heron studied Law at the Imperial Markian University and later pursued a military career. As part of the King’s Army, he held the rank of lieutenant until the dissolution of monarchy in 1923. Due to his marriage with the sister of General Luderin, he was implicated in the military coup of 1927 and the Sordish Civil War, but investigations were dropped during Tarquin Soll’s term as president. He joined the USP and became a member of the assembly in 1929.

He was a strong supporter of Tarquin Soll and the establishment, and became one of the leading members of the USP. He previously served as the Speaker of the Assembly, and an advisor to President Tarquin Soll. In 1945, he was appointed as the Minister of Justice and Law by the president. After Tarquin Soll’s resignation in 1949, Ewald Alphonso tried to isolate him within the party. In the same year, he was appointed as a justice to the Supreme Court.

He became infamous for his obstructionist methods against President Ewald Alphonso and his policies.

Heron Garaci is a jurist and politician, who is currently serving as the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court. He also served as the Minister of Justice and Law from 1945 to 1949.

Before his political career, Heron studied Law at the Imperial Markian University and later pursued a military career. As part of the King’s Army, he held the rank of lieutenant until the dissolution of monarchy in 1923. Due to his marriage with the sister of General Luderin, he was implicated in the military coup of 1927 and the Sordish Civil War, but investigations were dropped during Tarquin Soll’s term as president. He joined the USP and became a member of the assembly in 1929.

He was a strong supporter of Tarquin Soll and the establishment, and became one of the leading members of the USP. He previously served as the Speaker of the Assembly, and an advisor to President Tarquin Soll. In 1945, he was appointed as the Minister of Justice and Law by the president. After Tarquin Soll’s resignation in 1949, Ewald Alphonso tried to isolate him within the party. In the same year, he was appointed as a justice to the Supreme Court. He became infamous for his obstructionist methods against President Ewald Alphonso and his policies.

In 1956, Garaci was elected as the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Heron Garaci

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Isabel Edmonds is a Sordish jurist who has been serving as a Justice of the Supreme Court of Sordland since 1949. She is both the youngest person to serve in the High Court of Appeals and the first woman to serve in the Supreme Court.

After graduating from Holsord State University Faculty of Law, she began her career as a judge, serving in the cities of Conriat and Gelsord. She later became a supervisory judge in the High Court of Appeals in Holsord, later becoming a member in 1940. In 1949, she was appointed as a Justice of the Supreme Court by Ewald Alphonso, becoming the first woman to hold the position.

Edmonds is regarded to be a firm believer in democracy and secularism, and has spoken out against the ‘oppression of the Sollist state apparatus’ numerous times. She is known to hold anti-communist and socially conservative views.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Isabel Edmonds

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Orso Hawker is a Sordish politician, jurist and the current Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Sordland since 1937.

He graduated from Imperial Markian University in 1903 with a degree on legal theory. Later on, he started working as a public prosecutor and then as a judge at the local district court of Erlory until the fall of the Kingdom of Sordland. During the first government of the republic, he started working at the Ministry of Justice, where he became an assistant and contributed to legislative planning and constitutional law.

He joined USP after the coup in 1929 and was elected as a member of the assembly. He was known to have close ties with President Tarquin Soll, who appointed him as a judge of the 2nd Supreme Court in 1933. After the death of the first Chief Justice Gregor Marcia, Orso was elected to his position by the court in 1937.

The Hawker Court handed down several landmark rulings that significantly transformed criminal procedure, taxes, and other areas of the law. Many of the Court's decisions incorporated highly controversial policies of Tarquin Soll, including the approval of the Security Package Laws and ruling that the Bludish Freedom Party entering the elections was unconstitutional, effectively removing the Bludish identity from politics.

As a staunch establishment supporter, he represents the majority of the Supreme Court and he is regarded by some as the most powerful and divisive figure in Sordish politics.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Orso Hawker
