CodexEntryProperties.Title: Kingdom of Rumburg

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Agnolia, officially the Republic of Agnolia, is a parliamentary republic located in Eastern Merkopa. Its capital, Staalport, serves as the country's principal maritime, administrative, and customs center. The republic is currently governed by the centrist Nurist Democratic Union Party under Prime Minister Maartin Van Hoorten.

The name Agnolia derives from the Agno tribes who settled the region in the early seventh century. For centuries the Agno peoples lived under the dominance of the Markian tribes and later the Markian Empire. Statehood emerged in 1600 with the creation of the Kingdom of Agnolia. The monarchy lasted seventy-five years before Queen Lenna married Erik Renan of Sordland, forming the Agnolian-Sordish Commonwealth. This dynastic union endured until 1739 and was followed by the proclamation of the Republic of Agnolia in 1740. The early republic functioned as a merchant polity led by a Grand Stadehalder and the Grand Assembly, and during the Century of Revolutions evolved into a parliamentary system with an elected prime minister.

In the nineteenth century, the Land Conversion Acts dismantled aristocratic tenure and placed large estates under the Republican Sovereign Wealth Trust, transforming the country's institutional foundations. Staalport developed into one of the most important trading hubs in Eastern Merkopa. Throughout this period Agnolia relied on its relationship with Sordland as an informal counterweight to pressure from Rumburg and the Valgos Empire, while cooperation with Rumburg was viewed as a pragmatic counterweight to the growing power of the Valgos Empire.

A period of economic expansion in the late 1910s enabled naval modernization. In 1920, amid the collapse of the Valgos Empire, Agnolia occupied and fortified Heljiland. The following year it reclaimed Port Grim. Tensions with Rumburg escalated after the Agnolian High Court invalidated foreign inheritance claims over the Dome estates in May 1921, triggering the War of Broken Wills. The conflict concluded with the Treaty of Konstantium. Despite territorial losses, Agnolia preserved its sovereignty, parliamentary institutions, and control over the Staalport trade corridor. 

The economy receded in the late 1930s and the republic endured a major crisis in 1940, accepting financial aid from both United Contana and Arcasia. During the late 1940s, more than a million Agnolians emigrated to Sordland amid poverty and food insecurity.

The Otkende administration has prioritized infrastructure development, overseeing the construction of railways, tunnels, highways, and the expansion of shipyards and manufacturing sectors. However, the government faces criticism over its handling of ongoing conflicts on Helji Island between local Valgish and Agnolian populations, and its diplomatic posture toward Rumburg and the strategic city of Dome is widely perceived as passive. Unfavorable trade agreements with countries including Sordland, Lespia, Rizia, and Valgsland have contributed to a significant trade deficit, fueling public dissatisfaction.

The country's political landscape is organized around the Social Democratic Party, the Nurist Democratic Union, the nationalist-leaning National Vigilance Party, and the Civic Traditionalist Party, which maintains monarchist sympathies despite operating within the republican system. Limited Malenyevist and Valgslandian socialist sympathies are present among industrial and port communities.

The country is known for its steel, coal, and fishing industries, and has an average civil rights record with strong political freedoms. Agnolia is a member of OMEC and the Alliance of Nations and continues to advocate arbitration, maritime commerce, and multilateral diplomacy in regional affairs.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Republic of Agnolia

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Baronies of Soradis, commonly referred to as Soradis, are a decentralized feudal polity in North Merkopa composed of hereditary baronies rather than a unified crown. Its administrative capital is Gokord, a coastal fortress that hosts the Council of Barons. Soradis is a member of the Guild of Royal Allies for Commercial Exchange and the Alliance of Nations.

The population is predominantly Valg-descended, tracing its origins to the expansion of the Valgos Empire across the northern belt from the sixteenth century. Over time this population developed a distinct regional identity shaped by coastal trade, feudal landholding, and proximity to Rumburgian influence. Dastnurism is the dominant faith, though older Sky Gods traditions persist in rural areas.

Under Valgos rule the barons exercised considerable autonomy while maintaining imperial ties. Revolutionary unrest beginning in 1916 fractured imperial authority across the north. As syndicalist councils consolidated in what became Markanissa, Soradis barons resisted their expansion. Frontier clashes between 1916 and 1920 fixed the political divide between the baronial south and the revolutionary north

Governance operates through the Council of Barons, where hereditary rulers coordinate defense, trade, and foreign relations by consensus. The economy relies on fishing, timber, coastal trade, and interior mining linked to Rumburgian supply networks. During the 1930s and 1940s, Rumburg gradually integrated Soradis through financial backing, officer training, and administrative alignment. 

Soradis formally joined GRACE in 1943. Political freedoms remain limited under hereditary rule.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Baronies of Soradis

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
United Contana is a federalist socialist republic situated on the continent of Contana, and considered as a superpower of the world. It is a union of multiple socialist republics spanning Contana. The country is a one-party state, governed by the Communist Party with Kyow as its capital. It is led by Chairman Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua.

United Contana had its roots in the 1907 Revolution, when the revolutionaries of the Rotski, led by Malenyev, overthrew the Kontanian government which had replaced the autocratic regime of the king during the Century of Revolutions. In 1910, after a civil war ending in the Rotskis' victory, the United Contana was formed by a treaty that united the Kontanian, Transcontanan, Kyovian, and Byelocontanan republics of the Contana continent.

Malenyev replaced the market economy with a command economy which led to a period of rapid industrialization and collectivization in the United Contana. During this period, rapid economic development resulted in dramatic improvements in the average standard of living, particularly in urban areas. The country saw major reforms under the ideology of Malenyevism. It promoted the idea of the permanent revolution abroad and supported social revolutions in nearby states with early-stage capitalism. United Contana grew its influence around the world with Malenyevist ideas and rose to become a superpower of the world.

United Contana is currently locked in a fierce global ideological battle with Arcasia. Both powers are in a race of influence around the globe. United Contana has been growing its influence around the world by supporting less fortunate nations with their problems, supporting revolutionaries and unions abroad. They have already influenced several revolutions to occur which led to the founding of new Marco-Malenyevist nations.

The nation has a very strong economy and an average civil rights record with few political freedoms. Thanks to the education reforms and heavy promotion of sciences, they experienced a technological golden age and currently are considered to be ahead of their rivals in the world. The continent is very resource rich and United Contana uses this as a means to spread their influence around the globe. It tends to export natural resources more than any nation in the world, and in exchange, sets up military bases in strategic countries.

It is the founding member of the Contanan Security Pact (CSP) which was created against the growing threat of Arcasian Capitalism and neo-imperialism. It is also a permanent member of the Alliance of Nations.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: F.S.R. of United Contana

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Democratic Republic of Valgsland, commonly referred to as Valgsland, is a socialist republic located on the island of Valgos and its surrounding archipelago. Governed by the People’s Party, the nation is headquartered in the capital city of Haelm. Its current head of government is Chancellor Emmerich Hegel, under whose leadership the country has undergone wide-reaching reforms. 

Valgsland traces its cultural roots to the Valg tribes, who settled the island in the 11th century. Before their arrival, the region was home to the Galmanic peoples, and over time, Valgsland developed a unique insular culture, distinct from its continental neighbors in Mark and Sord. By the 16th century, Valgsland emerged as a formidable naval and colonial power. Known then as the Empire of Valgos, it held one of the largest navies in the world and maintained a vast colonial presence across Rika and Xina until the 19th century. 

Following decades of decline, the monarchy was overthrown in the Valgslandian Revolution of 1920, led by Wilhelm Ulbrik, who established a socialist state inspired by Malenyevism in United Contana. The early republic adopted a command economy, granted independence to Valgos’ former colonies, and pursued internal consolidation through extensive purges and centralized rule. 

Emmerich Hegel, a key figure in the revolution and long-time member of the ruling party, gradually rose through the political ranks. Though publicly aligned with Ulbrik, Hegel began advocating for an alternative socialist model known as Valgslandian Socialism, which emphasized decentralization, participatory governance, and regional economic autonomy. After Ulbrik’s death in 1940, Hegel was elected Chancellor and initiated a major political shift by distancing Valgsland from strict Malenyevist doctrine and reducing state repression through democratic reforms. 

Under Hegel’s leadership, Valgsland joined the Contanan Security Pact in 1946, reinforcing its regional security commitments while charting an independent ideological course within the socialist world. His reforms have transformed symbolic institutions into functional organs of governance, increased public participation in decision-making, and elevated civil liberties and living standards. 

Valgsland is now considered one of the most stable socialist states globally, with no unemployment, a robust social safety net, and a strong civil rights record. It has been designated an “example state” by the Alliance of Nations for its progressive reforms. The country is also a member of OMEC and maintains a permanent seat in the Alliance of Nations, affirming its role as a model for post-revolutionary development.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Democratic Republic of Valgsland

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Confederacy of Vendonesam, commonly referred to as Vendonesam, is a federation of monarchist states situated in the southeastern region of Xina, near the strategic Southern Line pass. Its capital, Kanthapur, serves as the center of political and cultural activities. As a prominent member of the Guild of Royal Allies for Commercial Exchange, Vendonesam is distinguished by its opposition to democratic and Malenyevist ideologies.

Vendonesam was established in the late 18th century under the leadership of Grand Duke Tunga Vanthu, uniting a collection of feudal states into a single confederation. Key states within Vendonesam include the Sultanate of Ragkara, the Holy Isles of Penguvi, and the Duchy of Tamaren. Its governance is unique, with a council of electors representing each member state. This council elects the Supreme Regent, the federation's leader, for a six-year term, ensuring a blend of tradition and political coordination among the monarchist states.

During the industrial era, Vendonesam focused on reinforcing its feudal structure by channeling industrial growth to support the existing social order. Its rapid modernization was significantly supported by the Kingdom of Rumburg, which bolstered Vendonesam's military and industrial capacity. These advancements were aimed at maintaining internal stability and deterring external powers such as the Empire of Valgos from influencing the region.

In the early 20th century, Vendonesam’s foreign policy revolved around resisting democratic and Malenyevist movements, shaping its regional relations. It played a prominent counter-revolutionary role during the Century of Revolutions in South Xina, positioning itself as a staunch defender of monarchist and traditionalist systems. 

By the mid-20th century, under leaders such as Prince Consort Kabauen Sang Tam, Vendonesam continued to uphold its feudal and monarchist structures. Key cities like Kanthapur, Suryanagara, Ragkara, and Penguvi remain vital to its governance and cultural identity. Despite global changes, Vendonesam’s adherence to its traditional power structures has ensured the persistence of its foundational political and social systems.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Confedaracy of Vendonesam

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Wehlen, officially the Republic of Wehlen, is a presidential republic located in Eastern Merkopa. The nation is currently governed by the Wehzek Nationalist Party of Nurist Socialism under the leadership of President Wiktor Smolak. Its capital city is Wraclawitz.

The state of Wehlen was established by Baron Warongrad Reczniek in 1630, who seceded from the Markian Empire to form his own kingdom in a region predominantly inhabited by the Wehzek people. Despite the Wehzek people's longstanding presence in the area, spanning over a thousand years, they had never before managed to unify under a single governmental entity.

Following a bloody revolution in 1914, the monarchical system was dismantled, replaced by a republic. This change heralded a short-lived economic boom, driven by the discovery of gold, diamond mines, and oil in the mountainous areas near Rumburg and Lespia. However, the nation's stability was shattered in 1930 when a civil war erupted following the assassination of the president by a Wehzek royalist. The country was split, with the conflict escalating further in 1930 due to foreign interventions from Arcasia backed the southern factions, while United Contana supported the northern factions. This period also saw armed rebel groups from neighboring Sordland establishing bases within Wehlen.

The civil war, which lasted until 1940, wreaked havoc across Wehlen, leading to widespread starvation, disease, and a massive refugee crisis. Despite the formal end of the conflict in 1940 and the re-establishment of the republic, Arcasian troops were withdrawn in 1936. United Contana then established a peacekeeping brigade in 1937 in Wraclawitz, which remained until 1943. The protracted period of turmoil fueled a strong anti-Arcasian sentiment, which played a significant role in the rise of the Wehzek Nationalist Party of Nurist Socialism. Wiktor Smolak, a pivotal figure during the post-war era, was elected president in 1943, subsequently steering the country towards a one-party state framework.

Despite being rich in natural resources like oil and diamonds, Wehlen is considered to have one of the weakest economies in Eastern Merkopa, exacerbated by its poor record on civil rights and political freedoms. It is often cited as the least favorable nation in Merkopa for starting a business.

Wehlen is a member of the Organization for Merkopan Economic Development (OMEC) and the Alliance of Nations, participating actively in regional economic and political initiatives.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Republic of Wehlen

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Confederacy of Yarktralis, located on the southernmost continent of Wulqanise, is a sovereign state known for its arctic landscapes and sustainable governance practices. The nation consists of semi-autonomous city-states unified under centralized control for foreign policy and defense, led by Elder Overseer Rangi Wiramutu. Yarktralis balances local autonomy with a national focus on innovation and survival in its extreme environment.

The capital city, Yaravia, represents Yarktralis’s ingenuity in adapting to the arctic. Constructed underground and powered by geothermal energy, Yaravia supports a sustainable civilization in one of the world’s harshest regions. This subterranean infrastructure minimizes energy waste while enabling resource-efficient living. While Yarktralis emphasizes sustainable technologies, its expansion into mining, geothermal drilling, and industrial development has disrupted local ecosystems, leading to the extinction of several rare species unique to the Wulqanise continent.

Economically, Yarktralis thrives on resource extraction and advanced arctic engineering, with innovations tailored to its environment. Terrain vehicles, high-pressure gas weapons, and balloon technology for scientific exploration highlight its technological prowess. Despite its isolationist stance, the confederacy maintains critical trade relationships, particularly with Anraka, exchanging mineral resources for advanced technology. This self-sufficiency minimizes reliance on external economies but often intensifies the ecological toll on its fragile arctic environment.

Yarktralis’s progress is shaped by its geography and competitive city-states, which drive innovation while central leadership ensures coordination for national objectives. While its focus on sustainability has mitigated some environmental damage, critics argue that its industrial projects have irreversibly altered Wulqanise’s biodiversity. Even so, Yarktralis has found ways to balance the challenges of its environment with technological advancement and long-term survival strategies.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Confederacy of Yarktralis

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Antel Rock is the most secure maximum-security prison in Sordland. It was built in 1941 under a security directive of Tarquin Soll's interior minister.

The octangular shaped compound houses the worst criminals Sordland has and is located on a large rocky half-island off the city Antel. Traitors, terrorists and subversives are all imprisoned and questioned in this daunting facility, that only had one sucessful escape attempt.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Antel Rock Prison

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Archsanctuary of Dastnurity is the most important religious building in Sordland. It is located in Deyr and is being managed by an Archpriest of Dastnurity.

Thousands of pilgrims visit this important landmark during the Day of Descension, to praise the message of God sent down to Saint Dast and his thirty disciples. The core structure of the temple dates back 3500 years and indicates that it was built at the same time as the Garden City of Crest.

The unique architecture of the Archsanctuary baffles architects, as it utilizes newer techniques, even though it is ancient. It was renovated in the 1900s under an initiative of the King and has since then been self-reliant.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Archsanctuary of Dastnurity

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Basilisk of Baal is an ancient historical monument in Lachaven. Visited by thousands of tourists every day, archaeologists suggest that it is more than 2500 years old.

The language written on the Basilisk indicates a completely different grammatical structure compared to Merkopan languages. Twenty years ago, a famous archaeologist named Ulzin deciphered the text, which indicated that it was a monument to the Moon God, who protected the people during the cold of the night.

The basilisk is one of the most popular spots to visit in Lachaven, together with the Library of Saint Wruhec.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Basilisk of Baal

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
It is the largest military base in Sordland, situated at the heart of Holsord. Camp Strongarm houses three divisions of troops totalling up to fifty thousand soldiers and a military airbase housing a hundred warplanes.

It was created by Colonel Soll after his coup succeeded to exert power in the capital for the longer-term. Currently, it protects the government of Sordland and has the capacity to rapidly redeploy to oppose any real danger a neighbouring country could impose.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Camp Strongarm

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Hill of Pride was named during the declaration of the Kingdom of Sordland, when thousands of countrymen started proudly singing the new anthem of Sordland. It is located at the center of Holsord, in between the most important government structures like the Maroon Palace, The Supreme Court, The Grand National Assembly and the Ministry of Interior.

The Hill of Pride is inside the large capitol park, which gives the Holsordians a chance to relax from the city stress with free time activities in nature. The hill has great symbolic importance because of the declaration of the kingdom and the republic which took place on top of it during the last century.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Hill of Pride

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
In the year 716, the world-famous library was built by Saint Wruhec and his loyal followers. It is a three-story marble building influenced by ancient Grecan architecture. The library contained the largest source of knowledge in the world.

Records indicate that in the year 1000, around eleven thousand books were stored here. The mission of the Library of Saint Wruhec was to gather and share valuable information. The duty of the librarians was to enlighten visitors no matter their question.

Disaster struck the library during the Markian conquest. While thousands of the most important books were saved from the pillaging Khan, the rest was intentionally burned to the ground by the raiders. The building barely survived and was restored in the late Renan period to serve as a historical site.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Library of Saint Wruhec

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Maroon Palace is where the executive branch of the Sordish government is situated. It was constructed to serve as the summer residence of Albrecht Renan, but quickly became a structure of political importance. The turning point was when the Kingdom of Sordland was announced from the balcony of the palace, reflecting the shift of government power from Erlory to Holsord during the transition period.

The Maroon Palace received its name from the maroon painted exterior walls. It has a hundred rooms and several wings housing different branches of executive government. Undearneath the structure is a highly secure situation room where the president is safe from any danger and evaluates any security crisis.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Maroon Palace

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Soll Dam (also called Erzaren Soll Dam) is the largest source of hydroelectricity in Sordland. The construction was started by order of President Tarquin Soll in 1933 as a solution to the energy crisis that had existed in the region for decades and to reduce the nation’s dependence on foreign energy. The contracts for constructing the facility were given to the Sordish State Corporation, the Sordish Grid Corporation, and Gasom.

The project was plagued with controversy and political problems due to the site being home to an old Bludish village called Izzam, which needed to be flooded for the dam to be built. In the construction process, the local people of Izzam were forcefully relocated, and the village was razed, causing a backlash from the local population and the Watchtower of Human Rights.

During the divisive relocation event, many Bludish locals came to protest and tried to stop the construction from starting. In the protests, a soldier fired his rifle, killing a local Bludish man named Watani Aschraf. This event, also known as the ‘Izzam Incident,’ caused turmoil in the region and led to the formation of the armed Bludish resistance movement called the ‘Bludish Freedom Front.’

The dam opened three years after the tragic event. Despite the tumultuous events, it proved to be a huge political success for Tarquin Soll in the following years especially praised by the majority of the country living in urban areas that faced blackouts. The country’s electricity output tripled, and the dam lake formed was named Soll. Today, it continues to fill the demand of the Bergia and Nargis regions with a majority and the rest of the nation.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Soll Dam

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Agnland, a strategic region of Sordland, shares its borders with the region of Nargis and the countries of Agnolia and Rumburg. Its capital city is Arvory, serving a sizeable population of Agno-Sordish, the second largest minority group in the country.

Geographically, Agnland is often seen as an extension of Greater Agnolia, reflecting its historical association with the neighboring country of Agnolia. The regional economy, heavily reliant on trade with Agnolia and the local fishing industry, has historically often struggled with stagnation. Coupled with high unemployment rates, this economic hardship has positioned Agnland as one of the more economically challenged regions in Sordland. Over the years, however, many Agnolian companies that used to operate within the region have relocated, leaving a palpable void in the local economy.

Agnland is bounded by the Eastern Sourne mountains in the north, marking its border with Rumburg. Agnolia lies to its northeast, and the vast Markian Sea flanks the region's eastern edge. The northern landscape is punctuated by hills and mountains, with minimal infrastructure, making traversing the area a challenging task. The region's coastal areas are characterized by bays, fjords, and precipitous cliff lines, underscoring the geographical diversity of Agnland. Agnland also lays claim to Duru Island where former President Tarquin Soll resides.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Agnland

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Bergia, a landlocked region of Sordland, is encircled by the regions of Nargis, Gelsland, and Greater Holsord, and the countries of Wehlen, Lespia, and Rumburg. The capital city, Deyr, is nestled in a river delta area in which many rivers pass and irrigate the farmlands. Bergia is home to a substantial Bludish population, the most significant minority in Sordland.

Sometimes referred to by its old Bludish name 'Bludia,' Bergia covers most of the geographical expanse of Greater Bludia, with the exception of northern territories in Wehlen and Lespia. Despite its thriving economy, the region struggles with high unemployment rates. Agriculture, mining, and steel manufacturing form the bedrock of Bergia's economy, with the Bergia Steel Corporation standing out as a prominent business. The region also houses the Soll Dam, a critical power source for Sordland.

For the followers of the Nurity faith, Bergia is a pilgrimage destination owing to the Archsanctuary of Descension located in Deyr. The region's geography is characterized by mountains on nearly all sides, including the Bergia mountains in the north, the Gumren and Taurus mountains along the western border with Wehlen, and the Maradun mountains towards the south bordering Lespia. 

The fertile river deltas nestled among these mountains are interspersed with cities and farmlands. Bergia also hosts a significant portion of the Maris forest, stretching from Sarna in the north to Gelsord.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Bergia

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Gelsland, bordering the regions of Nargis, Bergia and Greater Holsord, proudly hosts its administrative capital, Gelsord along with the cities of Ribery and Antel.

Gelsland's economy draws on a broad spectrum of industries. Many experimental factories and research and design centres find their home in the region, along with an array of small businesses. Known as Sordland's hub for technology and scientific exploration, Gelsord plays a leading role in shaping the regional identity. The past decade has seen a marked growth in production sectors, particularly those involved with mechanical engineering and the electronics industry. However, the output of these activities are often taken out of the city and to larger havens such as Lachaven or Holsord for business before the local benefit.

From a geographical perspective, Gelsland presents a remarkable array of natural features. The northernmost parts of the Maris forest spread out from Gelsord to Sarna, forming an integral part of the regional ecosystem. The Markian Sea coast on the eastern side of Gelsland carves out a dramatic coastline of bays, cliff lines, and tiny islands. Among these, the renowned Antel Rock and the infamous Antel Rock Prison stand as prominent landmarks.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Gelsland

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Greater Holsord, one of the most important regions of Sordland, shares its borders with Gruni, Gelsland, Bergia, and Lorren, as well as the neighboring country of Lespia. The region's governance operates from Holsord, the bustling capital of Sordland, boasting an impressive population density that sets it apart from other Sordish regions.

The economy of Greater Holsord is very robust and old, evident in its diverse industrial landscape. Large-scale businesses find their home in this region, with industries spanning from construction and logistics to mechanical engineering, as well as banking and some tourism. This economic dynamism lends Greater Holsord a competitive edge, setting it in close contest with the region of Nargis.

The geography of Greater Holsord is characterized by the serene flow of the Eskel River, tracing its path through Jen, Holsord, and Conriat. The northern coast of the region, lining the Markian Sea, is distinguished by the famed Conriat Bay, an attraction for locals and tourists alike. Moreover, the historical city of Erlory, the former capital, nestles within this region, adding a layer of historical depth to the modern vitality of Greater Holsord.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Greater Holsord

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Gruni, located within the borders of Sordland, is neighbored by Greater Holsord, Lorren, and the country of Lespia, enriching its cultural identity through this diverse interconnectedness. The bustling city of Valgen, a hub of historic and economic significance, stands as the region's capital. 

The economic landscape of Gruni is a vibrant amalgam of farmlands, factories, and world-renowned vineyards, from which the esteemed Borin wine originates. Gruni's agricultural richness and the scenic allure of its beaches draw a steady flow of tourists, adding a dynamic dimension to the regional economy.

Basking in its fertile environment, Gruni's expanses transform into verdant vineyards that form a cornerstone of the region's identity. Along its eastern edge, Gruni meets the Antacaen Sea, hosting the pivotal port of Benfi that boosts the region's connectivity and economic prospects. The shared border with Lespia enriches Gruni's cultural tapestry, resulting in a unique blend of customs, cuisines, and languages over time.

The Valgen Dam, an emblem of Gruni's progressive outlook and a marvel of engineering, contributes significantly to power generation and water management in the region. Its grandeur also enhances the touristic appeal of Gruni, attracting those drawn to the blend of architectural magnificence set amidst natural beauty. Gruni, with its economic vitality and distinct cultural identity, holds a central position in the diverse expanse of Sordland.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Gruni

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Lorren, nestled within Sordland, finds its borders shared with the regions of Greater Holsord and Gruni. Morna, the regional capital, is a testament to the industrious spirit of the people, even amidst historic economic challenges. 

The region's economy has faced new difficulties following the recession of 1951 but demonstrates resilience through its coal mining and factories, along with hosting the largest forestry industry in Sordland. The employment sector is significantly dominated by the Nedam Mining Group, Wudlan Forestry, and the Sordish Grid Corporations, underlining the region's focus on industrial output.

A defining characteristic of Lorren is its expansive forest cover, comprising the greatest number of trees in Sordland. These dense, verdant forests offer both ecological importance and an enchanting vista for the inhabitants and visitors. Additionally, the famous Rock of Maradune sits here, forming the closest geographical point to the neighboring Valgsland. This landmark serves as a symbolic reminder of the region's natural beauty and its close ties with its neighbors.

Lorren's geographical landscape is painted by the Markian Sea to its north and the Antacean Sea to its east, with its coastal line forming the southern border of the Gray Strait. This unique geographical positioning offers potential for marine activities and instills a sense of maritime identity in the region. Despite economic trials, Lorren stands as a region with substantial industrial output, abundant natural beauty, and a resilient spirit.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Lorren

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Nargis shares its borders with Agnland, Gelsland, Bergia, and Greater Holsord, as well as the neighboring country of Rumburg. Lachaven, known commonly as "The Gateway" is the economic nerve center of Sordland, serves as the regional capital and contributes significantly to the region's population density and economic output.

The economy of Nargis pulses with vitality, largely credited to Lachaven's role as a trade hub. Despite the robust economy, Nargis features expansive tracts of undeveloped land, the largest of such areas across Sordland. The region also boasts significant reserves of oil and other untapped natural resources, thus relying heavily on the oil and natural gas sectors, as well as agriculture and tourism. Gasom Corporation, a key player in the region, bolsters its economic profile with significant operations.

Geographically, Nargis is situated against the Sourne mountains to the north, bordering Rumburg, and the Cavendir mountain to the west. Its western expanse is characterized by hilly terrain interspersed with mountains, posing a significant challenge to infrastructure development and traversal. The region's eastern boundary graces the Markian Sea through the Gulf of Nargis, forming a scenic coastline adorned by bays and cliff lines.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Nargis

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
LesPower Corporation, headquartered in Perla, the capital of Lespia, is a prominent energy company and a major player in the global energy market. Counted among the influential "Magical Eight" corporations, it specializes in the extraction, processing, and distribution of natural gas and oil, with a strong focus on offshore gas fields.

By the 1940s, LesPower had significantly expanded its operations both domestically and internationally, pursuing a strategic agenda to enhance its influence in the energy sector. This growth was driven by substantial investments in advanced processing facilities, extensive pipeline networks, and a modern fleet designed for offshore exploration and global resource transportation. These initiatives highlight the company’s emphasis on technological innovation and infrastructure development, reinforcing its status as a leader in the global energy market.

Operating within Lespia’s protectionist economy, LesPower has become a foundation of the nation’s industrial and geopolitical strategies. Its alignment with national objectives and support from government policies, such as those introduced by the Lespian Capital Protection Agency, have further bolstered its competitive advantage both within the country and internationally.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: LesPower

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Rumburg Emerald Energy was founded in 1869 as a private–state corporation built on a hybrid ownership structure combining aristocratic capital, state backing, and foreign investment. A controlling stake was held by Edwin Halsecroft-Denwald, though the company operated as a joint-stock enterprise that attracted Arcasian financiers, Valgos capital, and participation from Agnolian merchant houses. 

While its earliest and most prominent operations developed in the resource-rich Dome basin, REE expanded across other regions of the kingdom through mining ventures, rail-linked extraction sites, smelting facilities, and port infrastructure. These networks connected inland resource zones with coastal export terminals and financial channels, establishing the company as a central pillar of Rumburg’s energy and metals economy and a key industrial instrument of the Halsecroft-Denwald family.

Over time REE developed into a vertically integrated energy and resources conglomerate with interests in mining, petroleum, natural gas, and transport infrastructure. Operations extended across multiple Rumburgian provinces while the company also invested abroad through resource concessions, shipping partnerships, and equity stakes in foreign energy firms. Under the Treaty of Konstantium in 1924, its Dome operations were incorporated into the Dome Economic Zone Authority under a multinational equity framework, before returning to direct corporate control after the mandate ended in 1949. 

REE maintained particularly strong commercial collaboration with firms and development agencies in GRACE and neutral bloc AN states, and by the mid twentieth century ranked among Rumburg’s largest corporations and a significant Merkopan energy actor.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Rumburg Emerald Energy

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Bergia Steel was founded in 1889 and is the largest fully private corporation among the Big Four, the companies at the center of Sordland's ownership debate. It is the primary steel manufacturer of Sordland and operates mainly in the Bergia region. It also works in steel construction projects and is highly successful due to the experienced architects and engineers they possess.

Bergia Steel has been contracted by Wehlen for several works close to the Sordish border, and this has led many to increase investments and trust due to its potential to rival the state corporations, which mainly dominate the public-sector contracts. Walter Tusk owns a majority stake in the corporation.

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Gasom is a privately owned Sordish energy company that mainly extracts natural gas and engineering complex machinery. Currently it is headquartered in Lachaven but it was originally incorporated in Holsord in 1925. Gasom is one of the largest corporations in Sordland. The Revolution’s Energy Department of United Contana had started the company as a joint venture with Sordish businessmen with the ambitions to influence Sordland economically. 

The political instability of the Coup of 27 and the following Sordish Civil War led the Contanan state to sell its shares. This left the board entirely to several Sordish businessmen who acquired the assets for cheap due to the post-civil war recession. 

In 1930 Ewald Alphonso, who had acquired a slim majority of the shares, was elected CEO. Under Alphonso’s tenure, Gasom hired world-class civil, electrical, mechanical, chemical, and petroleum engineers from the Anrakan Archipelago and Merkopa. The company expanded its primary operations around Narbel, in the Nargis region, where many untapped natural gas resources are located. 

The investment led by the corporation and the excavation in and around Narbel turned it from a town to a city, allowing the employment of all sorts for the local populace needing more urban development. The Nature Preservation Foundation criticized the damage to natural wildlife done by the corporation. Still, the corporation has fulfilled most of the gas needs of Sordland, increasing its energy independence and autarky strategy promoted by the Tarquin Soll government.

In 1932, Gasom sold a small part of its shares to the state under the nationalization initiative of Tarquin Soll to fund further operations. It applied for and won the contract award for the co-construction of the Erzaren Soll Dam. The highly talented engineers of Gasom were a vital propellent of the mega-project. 

Besides the state-owned Sordish State Corporation and the Sordish Grid Corporation contributing to the project, Gasom was the only majority privately owned corporation to work on the construction. The corporation grew rapidly and successfully until the mid-1940s and relocated its headquarters to Lachaven.

Ewald Alphonso resigned from his role as CEO and became the board’s chairman due to his pressing political ambitions in 1945. After the change in the leadership to a new CEO, the company has been stagnating and seeking further investment to increase its declining production capacity.

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Heart of Sordland Conglomerate (HOS) is a multi-industry corporation worth tens of billions of SR. Alongside Bergia Steel, it is one of the two privately held corporations among the Big Four. They are involved in many industries, but only have a monopoly in the media industry through the ownership of Sordland Today and the Sordish Broadcasting Corporation. They are heavily involved in radio, television, and advertising sectors. It was founded by Konrath Koronti, the first modern Sordish entrepreneur.

Sordish citizens employed by HOS enjoy many benefits, such as huge salary bonuses, free private healthcare and free housing. In the last decade, a leadership question has engulfed the organization, which slowed down its revenue, but it still remains a behemoth that can influence the economy, as well as the perception of the society on certain issues.

Recently, the eldest son of Konrath,Marcel Koronti has been the rising star of the conglomerate and the potential candidate for CEO.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Heart of Sordland Conglomerate

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
One of the largest state-owned mining corporations in East Merkopa is the Nedam Mining Group. Alongside the SSC, Nedam is one of the two state-owned enterprises among the Big Four. It primarily operates in the Lorren and Bergia regions, but also has limited operations in Wehlen, Lespia and Agnolia.

The corporation was formed in 1879, and started as a small family gold mining enterprise, but quickly rose to a large operation due to the resource needs of industrialization. It was nationalized in 1933 by President Tarquin Soll under the National Autarky Plan. Its’ largest extracted resources are coal, gold and diamonds, which generate high profit margins for the Sordish State.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Nedam Mining Group

It primarily operates in the Lorren and Bergia regions, but also has limited operations in Wehlen, Lespia and Agnolia.

It was nationalized in 1933 by President Tarquin Soll under the National Autarky Plan, and later privatized by President Anton Rayne. Its’ largest extracted resources are coal, gold and diamonds, which generate high profit margins for the Sordish State.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Nedam Mining Group

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Founded in 1899, the Sordish Grid Corporation is tasked with constructing and maintaining the energy infrastructure in the country. It is in charge of every government owned energy source and distribution.

It also specializes in their construction, in this field it is more experienced and efficient than other corporations. The fact that it is a government corporation does a cause a lack of competitiveness and oversight, but overall they have a good track record from building power stations to dams to power lines to desolate areas.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Sordish Grid Corporation

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Founded by the Renan family in 1849 as a state asset, the Sordish Petroleum is the main extractor of oil in Sordland. It is focused in and around Estord, where one of the three largest oilfields in the Merkopa continent lies.

The corporation ran into many issues due to the transitional governments and infighting between Sordish regimes, but has survived many political takeovers due to its strategic importance of fueling the critical transportation and manufacturing requirements of the state. Currently, it still extracts most of the oil needs of the country from the North of Nargis.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Sordish Petroleum

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Founded in 1891, the Sordish State Corporation (SSC) is the main government corporation tasked with running public construction contracts in Sordland. It is one of the two state-owned enterprises among the Big Four. Widely regarded as the most honorable company in the country, it has a long and solid track record of accomplishing critical projects.

In the recent years, the efficiency of the corporation seems to have dropped due to the recession and the somehow corrupt management structure. It is still considered the safest bet for big projects in the minds of many government officials.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Sordish State Corporation

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Founded in 1891, the Sordish State Corporation (SSC) was the main government corporation tasked with running public construction contracts in Sordland. It was one of the two state-owned enterprises among the Big Four, until President Rayne privatized it. It has since been renamed the "Sun of Sordland Corporation." Still commonly called the SSC, it was widely regarded as the most honorable company in the country, with a long and solid track record of accomplishing critical projects.

In recent years, the efficiency of the corporation seems to have dropped due to the recession and a somewhat corrupt management structure. It is still considered the safest bet for big projects in the minds of many government officials.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Sordish State Corporation

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Founded in 1946 by Geralt Fais, Taurus Holding is a new and entrepreneurial private company that uses cutting-edge construction technology from Arcasia to reduce construction costs and prices.

They recently began taking bigger and riskier contracts in several industries, including the construction industry. Taurus also deals with shipyard building, bridgeworks and training aircraft hangars. The company is known for its great employee perks and high union membership. It is considered much more open and competitive compared to the usual Sordish corporations. They are known for their port expansion project in Benfi which was completed with half the budget.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Taurus Holding

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The real estate giant is owned by the mayor of Conriat, Kris Schar. Most people in Sordland know the name Underhall Construction by the many iconic buildings they have constructed in nearly all major cities.

Recently, the company sold half of the shares to Walter Tusk, spokesperson for the Lotherberg Group. While this breached certain competition clauses it was largely ignored. Underhall is a gigantic real estate company that is very influential in construction projects of the private sector. Some of their recent work is the Holsord Central Station, which they have completed on time but violated workers rights in the process.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Underhall Construction

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
In the political lexicon of Sordland, 'The Old Guard' is a term used to denote a purported group of influential individuals within the government. The nature and influence of this group, however, are subjects of considerable debate and speculation.

The concept of 'The Old Guard' is often associated with theories of a deep state, a hidden network of power said to exert control over the state apparatus. This clandestine web of influence is rumored to permeate key organizations within the government, effectively shaping policy and decision-making from behind the scenes. Critics, however, dismiss such notions as urban myths, challenging the existence of such a widespread and influential entity.

It's widely speculated that 'The Old Guard' took root during the Soll era, functioning as a security mechanism to maintain control and stability within the government. However, the shroud of secrecy remains intact, as there have been no public admissions or definitive evidence to confirm the identities of its alleged members. This enduring ambiguity ensures 'The Old Guard' remains a subject of intrigue, conjecture, and controversy within Sordland's political landscape.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Old Guard

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The term "Oligarchs" in the context of Sordland refers to a select group of individuals who, through strategic acquisition of state assets during periods of privatization, have amassed significant wealth and control over extensive industrial networks. These elites, characterized by their economic influence, often emerge from economic liberalization periods, seizing the opportunity to purchase public assets at significantly reduced prices.

Several oligarchs are known to be affiliated with prominent groups such as the Lotherberg Group and the National Business Council, further solidifying their influence in both economic and political spheres. However, their reach extends beyond Sordland's borders, as they frequently engage in foreign direct investments, thereby securing their financial interests on an international scale.

Despite their affluence within Sordland, the oligarchs' precise role and influence within the nation's political and economic framework remain subjects of ongoing debate. Their ability to manipulate economic levers and shape policy decisions shows their substantial sway over the nation's trajectory. Yet, their propensity for foreign investments indicates a broader vision, one that acknowledges the importance of international economic interconnectivity. This duality is at the heart of understanding the role of oligarchs in modern Sordland.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Oligarchs

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Reformist Alliance, centered around the People’s Freedom and Justice Party (PFJP), represents a significant faction in the political landscape of Sordland. Historically, this alliance has brought together a variety of political ideologies, from socialists and communists to liberals, who find common ground in their shared aspiration for social and political reform. This faction's existence reflects a broader trend in Sordland's history, highlighting the nation's continual struggle between tradition and progress.

Challenges abound for the Reformist Alliance due to Sordland's electoral system, which critics argue disproportionately benefits established parties. This systemic bias has led to a significant power imbalance that curtails the Reformist faction's political influence and hinders their ability to effect meaningful change. Despite these obstacles, the alliance remains a powerful voice for reform and continues to shape political debate.

Intriguingly, the clamor for reform has echoed within the ranks of the United Sordland Party (USP) itself, where a faction advocating for liberal policies has emerged. This internal faction, although ostensibly part of the establishment, shares some common ground with the Reformist Alliance, adding another layer of complexity to Sordland's political scene. The persistence of the Reformist Alliance, coupled with the emergence of reform-minded elements within the USP, illustrates the evolving dynamics of Sordland's political landscape.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Reformists

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Anti-Corruption Police (ACP) is a domestic intelligence and security service of Sordland. The organization was founded by the 4th president of Sordland, Anton Rayne, in 1954 with its headquarters in Holsord.

The organization is given full authority by the presidency to investigate corrupt government officials and citizens in Sordland. The ACP functions as a sub-branch directly under the Ministry of Justice, led by Ms. Nia Morgna, while ground operations are organized and led by Greater Holsord Police Chief, Karl Greiser.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Anti-Corruption Police

During President Rayne's 1st term, the ACP uncovered a complex web of connections pointing to the high level of corruption within the Old Guard. The investigation found the main conspirators of the murder of Benard Circas to be Orso Hawker and Lileas Graf. Some connections are even pointing back to Colonel Tarquin Soll but no concrete evidence was found to solidify the case. Known as the Great Purge, the ACP arrested dozens of Assembly members and thousands of government officials.

During President Rayne's 1st term, the ACP managed to uncover proof of the NFP's leader involvement in the assassination of Bernard Circus. The investigation found that the murder was orchestrated by Mr. Kisaro Kibener and Mr. Remus Holstron with the collaboration of the Young Sord.

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Central Bank of Sordland is a financial institution of Sordland tasked with regulating the macro-economy by having control over policy instruments to use in achieving price stability for the Sordish Ren. It holds a large sum of foreign money reserves and is a semi-independent organisation located in both Lachaven and Holsord.

The current Chairwoman of the Central Bank is Edith Agnoc. In the last eight years the Central Bank has spent a lot of effort in curbing the effects of the damaging recession and has managed to stabilize the rate of economic loss to -2% of GDP. For her successful crisis management, Edith Agnoc has been praised globally.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Central Bank of Sordland

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Gendarmerie of the Republic of Sordland is an armed law enforcement organization which maintains security, safety and public order in the rural regions of Sordland and executes the duties ascribed to it by other laws. The Gendarmerie General Command is subordinated to the Ministry of Defense.

The Gendarmerie Organization, which was established in 1899, has survived until today. After the Republic was proclaimed, the gendarmerie stations began to serve people in the most remote parts of the country in addition to carrying out security and public order duties. During Soll’s term as president, most people began to identify Gendarmerie with the state itself.

It is currently led by the Speaker of the Assembly Gloria Tory, who also represents the conservatives within the United Sordland Party.

Sordish Armed Forces (SAF) are the military forces of the Republic of Sordland. With its headquarters in Holsord, SAF consist of the General Staff, the Land Forces, the Naval forces and the Air Forces. The current chief of the General Staff and the chief of the Armed Forces is General Valken Kruger.

In wartime, the Chief of the General Staff may act as the Commander-in-Chief on behalf of the President. The General Staff also holds the authority to reject a president’s candidate for the position of Minister of Defense, and may appoint its own candidate when they deem it necessary.

The Sordish military perceives itself as the guardian of Sollism, the official ideology of the second republic era of the Republic of Sordland.

The Sordish Armed Forces is the fifth largest standing military force in Eastern Merkopa after the Rumburgian Armed Forces. Currently, the military is a conscripted force; males serve in the military upon reaching the age of 18.

The Sordish Police Force is headed by Karl Greiser. The force has extensive rights and some argue more than most countries surrounding Sordland with the exception of Rumburg. These rights were given through the Security Package Laws of Tarquin Soll.

The police are tasked with enforcing the law in the country. They establish security, civil order and peace. As one of the very old institutions in the country, dating back to the Renan Aristocracy, a large section of society still heavily respects the force.

Internally, it is structured at regional levels which are tied to the ministry of interior led by Lileas Graf.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Sordish Police Force

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Special Zone of Bergia was a special administrative region in Sordland, covering the entirety of the region of Bergia. The headquarters of the zone used to be at Deyr and it was governed by an appointed governor, a special administrative position that only existed in Bergia.

Established during the critical era of President Tarquin Soll's emergency security program in 1935, the formation of the Special Zone was a direct response to the belligerence unleashed by the notorious Dewlen Arge and his declaration of war against the Sordish Republic. The zone was formed and structured specifically to counter the threat of the Bludish rebels and to ensure the suppression of the secessionist aspirations.

While adhering to the overarching principles outlined in the Sordish constitution, the Special Zone exercised a certain degree of autonomy in matters of internal security. This entailed complete control over its allocated security budget and the establishment of a specialized security force, known as the Bergian Security Force.

Contrary to the other regions of Sordland, the Special Zone did not conduct local elections. Instead, the pivotal responsibility for regional governance resided solely in the hands of the governor, who was appointed by the president every 6 years.

In 1957, after a massive demand from the locals, the Special Zone was officially dissolved.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Special Zone of Bergia

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Autonomous Zone of Bergia is a special administrative region in Sordland, covering the entirety of the region of Bergia. The capital of the zone is Deyr and it's governed by a regionally elected Bergian Regional Assembly which is led by an elected governor, a special administrative position that only exists in Bergia. The current governor is Ishval Ersen.

Established in 1957 with the approval of President Rayne, the Autonomous Zone replaced the non-representative structure of the Special Zone which previously existed between 1935-1957 to counter the threat of the Bludish rebels and to ensure the suppression of the secessionist aspirations within Bergia. 

While adhering to the overarching principles outlined in the Sordish constitution, the Autonomous Zone exercises a certain degree of autonomy in matters of civil, economic and security matters. The Bergian Regional Assembly may alter state laws and prevent certain policies from being followed within the region, as long as it operates within the boundaries prescribed by the Constitution.

The Secret State Police (SSP) is a domestic intelligence and security service. The organization was founded by the 4th president of Sordland, Anton Rayne, in 1954 with its headquarters in Holsord. The organization is given full authority by the presidency. Its goal is to detect and prevent subversive elements before any harmful action could be taken against the state.

The SSP functions as a sub-branch directly under the Ministry of Interior, Ms. Lileas Graf. While ground operations are organized and led by Greater Holsord Police Chief, Karl Greiser.

During the first term of the 4th president of Sordland, inside sources had leaked the existence of the organization to the press. The information was later confirmed at the impeachment trial of the president. Anton Rayne had ordered the SSP to commit hostile actions against his political rivals during his first term. These actions included evidence fabrication, assassinations, illegal detentions, kidnappings, death threats...

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Supreme Court of Sordland is the highest legal body for constitutional and judicial review. It examines the constitutionality, in respect of both form and substance, of laws, decrees having the force of law, and the Rules of Procedure of the Grand National Assembly. If necessary, it also functions as the Supreme Criminal Court to hear any cases raised about the President of Sordland, members of the Cabinet, or presidents and members of the high courts. The Justices of the Supreme Court may ‘hold their office during behaviour.’

The Supreme Court has the right to review enactments both before and after review, and it can invalidate whole laws or governmental decrees and prevent their application in future cases. The Supreme Court also functions as the second legislative body, when a proposal to change the Constitution of Sordland passes the Grand National Assembly of Sordland, giving them the final vote on constitutional changes. It is currently led by the Chief Justice Orso Hawker who was elected with a majority of seven to four in 1937.
