CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Alliance of Nations (AN) is an international entity founded in 1925 in response to the upheavals of the Century of Revolutions and the limitations of the earlier World Peace Concord, which had operated from 1913 to 1925 as a loose crisis forum. 

Conceived to enhance global cooperation, uphold international order, and cultivate peaceful interaction, the AN brought together numerous autonomous nations under a permanent charter. It inherited the Concord's experience in mediation and arbitration, including treaty oversight mechanisms first exercised in Konstantium, where neutral tribunals supervised postwar settlements and financial compliance.

The core of the AN's function lies in facilitating diplomatic discourse over issues of global import, encouraging member states to address disputes through structured procedures rather than force. The organization retains the authority to issue special resolutions through a supermajority vote, though this mechanism has been rarely used, with most disputes instead handled through special protocols and ad hoc commissions established within the Assembly framework.

The AN also maintains a sanctions mechanism, enacted by majority vote, allowing coordinated economic or diplomatic measures against states found in violation of its resolutions or charter principles. Its legal instruments include the Threat Mitigation Protocol, invoked in exceptional security cases, and the AN Directive on Offshore Resources, which affirms that a nation holds sovereign rights to undersea gas and oil wells located within 200 kilometers of its coastline, shaping maritime jurisdiction standards among members. The organization reflects the presence of distinct power blocs, most prominently those aligned with the Arcasian Treaty Organization and the Contanan Security Pact, whose rivalry shapes deliberations and complicates consensus.

Between these blocs, an informal neutral grouping has emerged, seeking procedural balance and moderating ideological confrontation within the Assembly. While several dozen nations remain outside its framework, the Alliance of Nations continues to shape the global political landscape as a central forum for negotiation, treaty monitoring, and managed competition among states, aspiring through collective effort toward a shared pursuit of peace, security, and cooperation.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Alliance of Nations

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Arcasian Treaty Organisation (ATO) is an intergovernmental military and economic alliance between 14 countries. Primarily led by Arcasia, the alliance aims to bring all it's members together in united economic and defense framework against CSP.

With ATO's strategic military alliance heavily consists of countries with capitalist economic structures. Its aim is to counter the influence of United Contana around the globe and protect Merkopa from the expansion of socialism.

Recently, the ATO has become increasingly focused on increasing the nuclear protection as the new military weapon has advanced enough to become part of warfare.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Arcasian Treaty Organisation

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Contanan Security Pact (CSP) is an intergovernmental military and economic alliance established in late 1946 by Chairman Leon Malenyev of United Contana. Formed in direct response to the creation of the Arcasian Treaty Organization (ATO), the CSP serves as a unified defense and economic bloc against the growing influence of Arcasian capitalism.

Led by United Contana, the alliance primarily consists of states with planned economies that engage in resource-sharing and centralized trade. Its core objective is to protect the sovereignty of socialist nations and prevent the expansion of liberal capitalist influence across Contana and beyond.

In recent years, the CSP has sought to extend its geopolitical reach into Merkopa by strengthening cooperation with aligned nations such as Valgsland. Through military coordination, ideological solidarity, and regional partnerships, the pact remains the principal counterweight to ATO-led initiatives in the ongoing global rivalry.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Contanan Security Pact

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Guild of Royal Allies for Commercial Exchange (G.R.A.C.E.) is an international monarchical network founded in 1831 during the Century of Revolutions to foster economic cooperation and mutual security among royal states. It emerged in response to the decline of absolutist systems and the rise of representative governments, nation-states, and socialist movements. By linking monarchies in a structured framework of trade, credit, and defensive coordination, GRACE provided a platform for them to preserve influence and stability amid shifting political dynamics.

It also carries a distinct political culture. Dynastic marriages between member houses serve as instruments of alliance, while court exchanges, shared ceremonial traditions, and elite education networks cultivate a common identity that frames monarchy as a living system of governance rather than an inherited relic. This has made GRACE as much a community of political values as an economic bloc.

The guild spans Merkopa, Rika, Xina, the Anrakan Archipelago, Contana, and beyond, but operates without a single permanent charter. It functions through layered agreements coordinated primarily by the Kingdom of Rumburg, one of its founding and most prominent members. Integration deepened over the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries through tariff and credit protocols, common customs and shipping instruments, the formation of the defensive Aegis Cell intelligence framework, and the beginning of military training cooperation. Under Queen Beatrice Livingston, reforms accelerated: internal tariffs were removed and customs rules unified in 1932, arms coordination began in 1935, joint industrial investment programs followed in 1939, and the Aegis Ears officer training initiative was established in 1942. By 1945, member states had begun laying the groundwork for monetary coordination.

Members include Rumburg, the Principalities, Nahrburk, the Kingdom of Rizia, the Baronies of Soradis, the Holy Kingdom of Al-Riqar, the Confederation of Vendonesam, and the Kingdom of Nalipurna. Soradis formally integrated in the 1940s, the only member incorporated through gradual soft integration rather than founding membership.

GRACE is a monarchical bloc bound by economic interdependence, security coordination, and dynastic alignment rather than by centralized supranational authority. Its trajectory under Beatrice has moved it from a loose network of mutual interest toward an increasingly standardized system, raising questions among observers about whether GRACE is evolving into a formal political union or remains, by design, a flexible instrument of Rumburgian influence.

$items: The Guild of Royal Allies for Commercial Exchange

CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Guild of Royal Allies for Commercial Exchange

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Organization for Merkopan Economic Development (OMEC) is an inter-governmental economic organization founded in 1921 to stimulate economic progress and increase trade in Merkopa.

It is a forum of countries describing themselves as committed to prosperity, providing a platform to compare policy experiences, seeking answers to problems, identify good practices and coordinate international policies of its members.

OMEC uses its wealth of information on a broad range of topics to help governments foster prosperity and fight poverty through economic growth and financial stability. The structure is based on continued monitoring of events in member countries as well as outside the member area and includes regular projections of short and medium-term economic developments.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Organization for Merkopan Economic Development

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Watchtower of Human Rights (WHR) is an inter-governmental human rights organization made up of roughly 1400 staff members around the globe.

Established in 1918, Watchtower of Human Rights is known for fact-finding, impartial reporting, use of media and targeted advocacy. Often in partnership with local human rights groups, each year, WHR publishes more than 40 reports and briefings on human rights conditions in some 26 countries, creating coverage in local and international media.

With the leverage this brings, WHR meets with governments, the Alliance of Nations, regional groups like OMEC and the United Peoples Pact to press for changes in policy and practice that promote human rights and justice around the world.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Watchtower of Human Rights

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Alphonso Foundation is a non-profit organization founded in 1953 by Ewald Alphonso, the third President of Sordland. After stepping away from politics, Alphonso redirected his focus towards charitable pursuits, channeling his resources to establish this organization.

The foundation primarily focuses on addressing homelessness and mitigating income inequality. It adopts a comprehensive approach in combating homelessness by not only providing immediate aid but also working towards long-term solutions such as affordable housing and employment programs. The foundation's initiatives related to income inequality involve efforts to promote fair wages, improve access to education, and support policies that favor economic balance.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Alphonso Foundation

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
FC Anrica is a Sordish professional football club based in Anrica, that plays in the Sordish Superliga, the top tier in Sordish football. Founded as Markiansport in 1905, the club changed to various names before settling on being called after its home city in 1923 as FC Anrica. Since 1940, FC Anrica’s home ground has been the Maroon Stadium, nicknamed ‘The Hall of Martyrs’, one of the largest stadiums in Sordland and in all Eastern Merkopa.

FC Anrica is known as a people's club with a huge national support, particularly from the Greater Holsord region. The club has a longstanding rivalry with FC Gelsord. Its anthem is ‘Eye-to-Eye, Tooth-to-Tooth’.

FC Anrica has been playing in the Sordish Superliga since the league’s inception in 1944. They are the one of the only two teams who had managed to claim the league title apart from FC Gelsord.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: FC Anrica

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
FC Gelsord is a Sordish professional football club based in Gelsord, that plays in the Sordish Superliga, the top tier in Sordish football. Founded in 1904, FC Gelsord has been the most successful club in Sordland. FC Gelsord plays at the Artor Wisci Arena, which opened as the Soll Arena in 1935 and was renamed in 1949.

FC Gelsord has a huge national support, particularly from the Gelsland and Nargis regions. The club has a longstanding rivalry with FC Anrica. Its anthem is ‘FC Gelsord is the only way forward’ which is derived from the city of Gelsord’s official motto ‘Science is the only way forward.’

FC Gelsord has been playing in the Sordish Superliga since the league’s inception in 1944, winning almost all Superliga titles since.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: FC Gelsord

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Holsord State University is a public research university located in Holsord, Sordland. It is the second oldest institute after the Markian Imperial University. The current rector is Sander Navek.

The HSU has educated many notable alumni, including the Speaker of the Assembly Gloria Tory, the famous political scientist Herman Equa, Justice of the Supreme Court Isabel Edmonds. As of 1954, 7 Renan laureates, 6 Avns Medal winners, and 1 Merkopa Science Award winner have been affiliated with the university. Alumni of the HSU have established strong, respectable positions in the legal, technological, and literary hubs of the world.

The HSU is generally accepted as one of the leading higher educational institutions in Eastern Merkopa.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Holsord State University

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
One of the most notorious criminal organisations in Sordland is the Koranelli Cartel. It's roots are dating back to the late 1880's and have started with bootlegging during the Kingdom period. Their operations are mainly focused around Nargis and Agnland.

For decades the Sordish Police Force has been fighting the organisation with dedication but the results only helped keep it's operations at bay. Their headquarters are expected to be in Estord and their primary focus is illegal drug and organ trafficking.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Koranelli Cartel

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Lotherberg Group is a private non-government organization which assesses the economic conditions of Sordland and the globe. Currently, the spokesman of the organization is Walter Tusk, who was elected by a majority vote. Officially, Lotherberg has a vague structure and limited leadership roles, but the spokesman is considered to be the de-facto leader of the entity. The Group convenes every three months at Hotel Berg in the village of Lotherg.

The meetings are held in secret, but reports suggest that they cover topics such as the economy, security, and international politics in detail. While most of its members remain unknown, the group consists of the wealthiest figures in Sordish society. The only public-facing member is Walter Tusk, who serves as its official spokesperson.

Due to the influential nature of the organization and the privacy of their affairs in the eyes of the public, theories have sprung up that the future of Eastern Merkopa is decided at these conferences.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Lotherberg Group

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Lotherberg Group is a private non-government organization which assesses the economic conditions of Sordland and the globe. It was led by Walter Tusk, who was recently replaced by Kris Schar with a majority vote. Officially, Lotherberg has a vague structure and limited leadership roles, but the spokesman is considered to be the de-facto leader of the entity. The Group convenes every three months at Hotel Berg in the village of Lotherg.

The meetings are held in secret, with reports suggesting that they cover topics such as the economy, security, and international politics in detail. While most of its members remain unknown, the group consists of the wealthiest figures in Sordish society.

Due to the influential nature of the organization and the privacy of their affairs in the eyes of the public, theories have sprung up that the future of Eastern Merkopa is decided at these conferences.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Lotherberg Group

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Magnus Cartus is an NGO founded in the early years of the republic, which gained prominence during the Alphonso period. It aims to make Sordland a more democratic nation by introducing a new charter of rights. It supports humanistic ideals and organizes peaceful conferences and protests.

Some of the donors are from Arcasia, but overall the founders are seen as peaceful citizens who have a good moral standard. In the last decade, MC gained attention through a whistle-blower inside the USP who leaked damaging documents about Tarquin Soll. This caused many to treat them as traitors to the state.

The founder denies allegations of being a traitor, explaining that being a vocal citizen fighting for the well-being of the country has nothing to do with betraying the nation.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Magnus Cartus

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Cerberus International, sometimes referred to as CI, is a prominent private military company headquartered in Arcasia and Kyrute. Operating with considerable autonomy, Cerberus pursues contracts in conflict zones and resource-rich areas worldwide. While its operations occasionally align with Arcasian interests, the company maintains independence from state control. Notably, approximately half of Cerberus's contracts are with non-Arcasian clients, demonstrating its global reach and diverse clientele.

The organization has faced accusations of destabilizing activities in various regions, including alleged involvement in piracy and unauthorized resource extraction. These controversies have sparked international debates on PMC accountability and regulation. Despite these challenges, Cerberus continues to secure lucrative contracts in unstable and conflict-prone regions.

Beyond its base in Ventrie City, the company maintains a strong presence in Konstantium. This strategic position near AN and other international organizations has allowed Cerberus to extend its influence beyond Merkopa and establish footholds in key areas of Xina and Rika. The firm has recently shown involvement in Arcasian domestic politics, supporting political candidates and engaging in lobbying activities.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Cerberus International

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Dome Economic Zone Authority was established by the Treaty of Konstantium in 1924 as a multinational economic governance body for the Dome basin following the War of Broken Wills. Its mandate, set for twenty-five years from 1924 to 1949, covered extraction, industrial development, and common standards across the region.

Ownership was structured with Rumburg holding 55 percent, Arcasia 20 percent, Valgsland 15 percent, and Agnolia 10 percent with full voting rights, and early dissolution required a seventy-five percent supermajority and fair-market buyout of all shares. The World Peace Concord initially monitored compliance and referred disputes to neutral arbitration seated in Konstantium. Following the Concord's dissolution in 1925, oversight transferred to its successor authority, the Alliance of Nations, which supervised DEZA for the remainder of its mandate.

DEZA oversaw timber, mineral, oil, and gas extraction alongside rail links, smelting, refining, harbor facilities, and trade finance mechanisms tied to export markets. Under the postwar settlement, Agnolia paid 200 metric tonnes of gold in reparations to Rumburg between 1924 and 1933, while receiving 25 percent of DEZA net profits from 1924 to 1939 in addition to lawful port and tax revenues. After 1939, Agnolia retained its 10 percent equity share and corresponding dividend rights for the remainder of the mandate.

The Staalport Corridor provided preferential transit for DEZA exports under joint commercial administration while affirming Agnolian sovereignty. The authority remained in force until the expiration of its mandate in 1949, after which Dome's industrial operations returned to direct corporate and state control, principally under Rumburg Emerald Energy.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Dome Economic Zone Authority

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Geopolitico is an international broadcasting organization headquartered in Konstantium, Kyrute. The institution traces its origins to 1853, when it was founded as a political and diplomatic news bureau serving merchants, diplomats, and foreign correspondents operating through Kyrute’s financial and maritime networks under the Valgos Empire. 

Over the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries it developed into a major international news organization, reinforced by Kyrute’s role as a neutral diplomatic and financial center. The organization operates through a decentralized reporting structure, maintaining regional headquarters in stable states across each continent while relying on small correspondent cells positioned in major political and economic flashpoints. 

In the late 1940s Geopolitico expanded into television broadcasting as new technological advances transformed the media landscape during the geopolitical rivalry between ATO and CSP. The organization gained international recognition through its political television programs.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Geopolitico

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Konstantium Defender, commonly referred to simply as "The Defender", is a major newspaper published in Konstantium, Kyrute. Founded in 1812, the publication was initially financed by the wealthy Valgos merchant family Fughaner, a prominent trading and banking dynasty active across Merkopan commercial networks. Over the course of the nineteenth century the paper gradually distanced itself from its original backers, and in 1886 its editorial leadership repurchased the a part of the Fughaner’s shares to secure majority ownership and retain stronger editorial independence. 

The Defender later developed into one of Kyrute’s most influential print media institutions and a central voice of the traditional press during the transition from newspaper dominance to broadcast journalism in the mid-twentieth century. The paper became known for investigative reporting and extensive political coverage connected to Kyrute’s diplomatic and financial role in international affairs. 

It served as an early training ground for several prominent journalists, including senior journalist and managing editor Tuomas Sacker.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Konstantium Defender

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Palantor Security Solutions, often referred to as PSS, is a private military corporation closely associated with the Arcasian government and armed forces. Unlike more independent PMCs, Palantor functions as a quasi-official extension of Arcasian military capabilities, often operating in coordination with state directives. This close relationship grants Palantor access to advanced Arcasian military technology and intelligence.

The company has a strong presence within the Arcasian defense complex. Palantor operates several defense manufacturing factories, producing equipment and weaponry for both its own use and the Arcasian military. PSS is deeply involved in the defense industry, playing an integral role in Arcasia's military infrastructure and strategic planning.

Palantor specializes in providing security for Arcasian interests both domestically and abroad. The company is rarely involved in managing civil unrest within the extended territories of the country. Internationally, Palantor has taken part in Arcasia's military transition strategies, assuming control of operations in sensitive areas where Arcasia seeks to reduce its official military footprint.

Its primary focus is on countering the influence of rival power blocs, particularly the Contanan Security Pact, and safeguarding ATO supply chains.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Palantor Security Solutions

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Halsecroft-Denwald family traces its origins to the 1841 marriage between Grand Duke Osrik van Denwald of Dome and Grand Duchess Maeryn Halsecroft of Tzarsbourgh, which united a historic Agnolian feudal dynasty with a prominent Rumburgian noble house. 

Members of the family later emerged as leading diplomatic proponents of the Treaty of Crimsrad and the opening of alternative trade corridors with neighboring states, reflecting their long-standing involvement in the kingdom’s commercial and foreign policy affairs.

When Osrik died in 1867, his will granted Maeryn and her children lifetime rights to the Dome estate and named their son, Edwin Halsecroft-Denwald, as sole heir under both Agnolian and Rumburgian law. This cross-border inheritance integrated the family into Rumburg’s aristocratic hierarchy, where they came to be regarded as one of the Five Families, the most influential noble houses in the crown lands. Their standing rests on inherited titles, large industrial capital, and a lasting presence in court and parliamentary circles. Several members have historically served in the Crown’s advisory institutions, senior administrative posts, and the armed forces high command.

During the late nineteenth century the family converted part of its landed wealth into industrial and corporate holdings through the creation of Rumburg Emerald Energy. The company developed major mining and extraction operations and linked the house to the country’s expanding energy and heavy industry sectors. The family was initially aligned with the CRP, which favored industrial modernization and more parliamentary governance. As tensions with Agnolia intensified and the status of the Dome estate came under threat, they shifted toward the hawkish Greater Rummish Union Party and formed a close alliance with the Wulfsbury noble house, whose interests in military production and rail infrastructure complemented their own.

The Dome inheritance later became the center of a prolonged cross-border legal dispute after Agnolia’s Land Conversion Acts transferred aristocratic estates into the Republican Sovereign Wealth Trust. From 1890 onward the question of succession appeared repeatedly in Agnolian and Rumburgian courts, culminating in the Agnolian High Court’s decision in May 1921 to void Osrik’s will and invalidate foreign inheritance claims. The ruling pushed the conflict into a diplomatic crisis that escalated into the War of Broken Wills.

Leadership passed in 1921 to Edwin’s eldest son, Jonathan Halsecroft-Denwald, who guided the family through the war and the subsequent settlement while preserving its industrial and political position. His twin sister Eleanor Halsecroft-Denwald maintained the family’s social and philanthropic networks, reinforcing alliances across court and commercial circles. 

In the immediate aftermath of the conflict the family relied on political maneuvering to reduce public scrutiny from the people surrounding its estates and corporate interests. During this period the allied Wulfsbury family lost several enterprises and landed estates that were taken over and nationalized by the Crown, a rare occurrence in the kingdom’s history. The outcome reduced scrutiny on the Halsecroft-Denwalds while shifting political pressure onto their former partners.

By the early 1950s a fourth generation had entered public life. Geoffrey Halsecroft-Denwald strengthened the family’s international alliances through his marriage to Dara-Kiri Surya of the Suryavongsa family.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Halsecroft-Denwald Family

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Suryavongsa family, most commonly known as the Suryas, rose to prominence in the early centuries of the Mousser Empire through maritime trade and powerful shipping syndicates. Ties at court secured noble recognition and access to political and commercial intelligence, enabling expansion into banking, agriculture, and overseas ventures, including imperial expeditions and early colonial enterprises. During the regional conflicts of the Century of Revolutions, the family further expanded its influence through extensive sovereign lending to warring states. 

Devout adherents of Zaranism, the Suryas combined religious patronage with commercial influence across multiple courts. They maintained a presence in the Kingdom of Arcas and the Valgos Empire and, for a time, operated a branch linked to the Kingdom of Kontana, as well as to other Xinan and Rikan powers. Early rivalries between branches ended in consolidation under a dominant matriarch who centralized control and formalized a unified financial structure.

After the fall of the Mousser Empire, the family reconstituted itself as a transnational financial and industrial network with holdings in shipping, energy, trade, and advanced manufacturing, including airplane and airship production in Qinal, Lespia, and Rumburg. The Suryas are represented in major economic groupings such as OMEC, XEC, and CRED, while preserving a reputation for strict discretion and tightly controlled internal governance across their branches. In recent decades, philanthropy and institutional patronage have become central to their public standing, while core capital operations remain firmly family-controlled. 

Over time, the dynasty intermarried with a range of prominent houses and wealthy families, including ties to the Halsecroft-Denwald family, owners of Rumburg Emerald Energy. Such alliances are generally viewed as part of the matriarch’s long-term commercial alignment and dynastic consolidation efforts. Journalists who have attempted to investigate the family have never gained access to key members or insight into its internal workings.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Surya Family

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The World Peace Concord was an international diplomatic forum convened in 1913 during the final phase of the Century of Revolutions to provide a venue for crisis mediation and limited coordination among states. 

Situated primarily in Konstantium, Kyrute, while periodically rotating sessions among major neutral capitals, it functioned as a flexible gathering point rather than a fixed institution. Its establishment was shaped by mounting geopolitical strain in the late revolutionary period, mainly the fall of the Valgos Empire and the far-reaching territorial, political, and economic realignments that followed it.

The empire’s collapse altered regional balances of power, produced new successor states, and intensified disputes over borders and spheres of influence, adding urgency to calls for structured diplomatic engagement. Operating without a permanent charter or centralized authority, the Concord relied on periodic conferences and ad hoc commissions, mediating several late-revolutionary conflicts with uneven and often limited results.

After the War of Broken Wills, the Concord oversaw the negotiation and initial enforcement of the Treaty of Konstantium, with Konstantium emerging as a regular congregation point for diplomacy and arbitration. In 1925, member states dissolved the Concord and transferred its remaining functions to the newly founded Alliance of Nations.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: World Peace Concord

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The infamous Skinner Cartel has received it's name from their old methods of skinning their enemies alive. They are mostly operating in the Bergia and Nargis regions and have indulged in black market arms trade since the 1910's.

The Skinner's haven't been getting along well with the Koranelli Cartel due to a conflict of interest in their criminal networks. However when it comes to avoiding the police both cooperate whenever they can to survive the day.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Skinner Cartel

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Sordish League of Women is a prominent non-governmental organization (NGO) primarily focused on advocating for women's rights in Sordland. It is recognized for its influential role in fostering gender equality, raising social awareness, and propelling progressive change in the nation.

The organization is well known for its significant initiatives, such as organizing large-scale fundraising campaigns and peaceful protest marches. These actions are designed to mobilize public opinion and generate resources for the cause of gender equality. Notably, the Sordish League of Women has called attention to pressing issues such as domestic violence, the gender wage gap, the lack of maternity leave, and systemic sexism in the educational sphere.

Demonstrations organized by the League have, at times, been met with opposition from conservative and religious groups, reflecting the societal divisions that persist in Sordland. Nevertheless, the organization persists in its advocacy, tirelessly working to safeguard and advance women's rights. The Sordish League of Women has also been linked to the efforts of First Lady Monica Rayne, who shares a similar agenda for women's rights in Sordland.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Sordish League of Women

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Ekonomists is a newspaper primarily focused on the financial developments around the world with political analysis related to those subjects. Founded in 1888 it is the primary newspaper read by those interested in the business world.

The newspaper has been criticized for being a proponent of capitalism in Sordland but in response has declared that each piece written is by a different editor and have shown data proving that they have differing opinions. The newspaper has many old economists from the Wisci era as well as new editors from the Alphonso era who were the supporters of the privatization effort.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Ekonomists

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Radical is one of the most critical and anti-establishment newspapers in Sordland. Many of the previous journalists from the newspaper have been arrested in the Soll period. People who are critical of the government and the recent events tend to flock to this newspaper.

Founded after the toppling of the first President of the Republic of Sordland it's motto always has been critical thinking. Their unchecked voice was mostly not welcomed by government officials who often tried to silence the newspaper, but still has not managed to do so. The Radical wants radical change in Sordland and they are not afraid to voice their opinions.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The Radical

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) is a Bludish militant and political organization based in the Bludish regions of Sordland and Wehlen. Since the Izzam Incident in 1933, the BFF has been involved in an armed conflict with the Sordish state, with an aim of achieving an independent Bludish state. They were created in protest against Sordland’s oppression of the Bludish people and heavily promoted Bludish nationalism among the local community.

The BFF was founded in the village of Zensehir in 1933, by a group of students who were part of the protest in Erzaren against the Soll Dam project and witnessed the shooting of Aschraf, more commonly referred to as the ‘Izzam Incident’. They initially called themselves ‘Followers of Aschraf.’ They have been involved in many armed clashes with the police and military forces of Sordland since their foundation. In 1935, led by Dewlen Arge, they announced a Bludish uprising and started a full scale insurgency in the region of Bergia.

In 1944, their leader Arge was captured and imprisoned. The attacks have ceased in number in the following years, and after the departure of Soll in 1949, there has not been any single attack made by the organization.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Bludish Freedom Front

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The LUS is the oldest NGO of Sordland. Its current spokesperson is Katarina Horten. The Labour Union aims to create better working conditions for all by organizing the workers inside companies and calling them to organize big strikes to disrupt services or production.

Many seem to regard the Labor Union as a foreign influenced NGO but there hardly seems to exist any proof on the matter. In the past decades it has been unexpectedly successful in increasing the wages of workers in several industries, but their greatest achievement was in the year of 1914 when they led a large miners strike in Estord and challenged the king.

Needless to say, the royal guards tried to oppress the workers, who they saw as revolutionaries. The royalists failed, and the king gave in on the advice of the economic advisor of the time, Heron Walt. Ever since that time, the LUS has been snatching minor victories against big companies.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Labor Union of Sordland

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The LUS is the oldest NGO of Sordland. The Labour Union aims to create better working conditions for all by organizing the workers inside companies and calling them to organize big strikes to disrupt services or production.

Many seem to regard the Labor Union as a foreign influenced NGO but there hardly seems to exist any proof on the matter. In the past decades it has been unexpectedly successful in increasing the wages of workers in several industries, but their greatest achievement was in the year of 1914 when they led a large miners strike in Estord and challenged the king.

Needless to say, the royal guards tried to oppress the workers, who they saw as revolutionaries. The royalists failed, and the king gave in on the advice of the economic advisor of the time, Heron Walt. Ever since that time, the LUS has been snatching minor victories against big companies.

Its’ former spokesperson Katarina Horten was arrested by the orders of President Rayne in 1957.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Labor Union of Sordland

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Bludish Freedom Party (BFP) was a Bludish political party in Sordland, which was banned from politics in 1933 for its alleged connections to the Bludish Freedom Front (BFF.)

BFP was formed in 1924 as a political party representing the many Bludish people living in southern Sordland and campaigned heavily for minority rights. They were expected to be elected as the main opposition party in the 1927 elections, which was cancelled after General Luderin executed a military coup and suspended the Constitution.

The 1933 Izzam Incident, which triggered the formation of the first Bludish resistance movement called Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) inspired many Bludish people to join their ranks, among them were ex-members of the BFP, which prompted attacks from the government. Following the terrorist attacks organized by the BFF, Tarquin Soll accused BFP of supporting them and banned the party out of politics in 1933. Bludish representation has been absent from politics since then, until the founding of the Workers Party of Bludia in 1948.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Bludish Freedom Party

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Communist Party of Sordland (CPS) is a communist political party in Sordland. It was founded in 1950 with hopes to bring together the many separate left-wing organizations in Sordland under one flag. The party has positioned itself between Malenyevism and Valgslandian socialism.

The party was established by a group of Malenyevist politicians, union leaders and a number of activists who were previously persecuted during Tarquin Soll’s term as president. It is considered as a continuation of the political party with the same name that existed in the early years of the Sordish republic, which was destroyed during the military coups and conflicts of the 20’s.

In the 1953 elections, the party won 8% of the vote, barely missing out on crossing the 10% election threshold in Sordland.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: Communist Party of Sordland

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The National Front Party (NFP) is a nationalist ultraconservative political party in Sordland, which currently is the second biggest opposition party in the Grand National Assembly of Sordland. It is led by Kesaro Kibener. 

The NFP was established in 1931 by a group of young nationalists, including Kesaro Kibener, in the city of Jen. The party mainly followed an ethnic nationalist political agenda with aggressive and threatening campaigns throughout the 30’s, which made it to be perceived as an extremist party, but later moderated its views under the leadership of Kesaro Kibener, who took over the leadership in 1949 and worked towards making the party more approachable for a larger audience. 

In the 53’ elections NFP gained the best results in its history, becoming the third biggest party in Sordland.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The National Front Party

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The People’s Freedom and Justice Party (PFJP) is a political party in Sordland which has promoted both liberalism and social democracy in the country. It is currently the main opposition in the Grand National Assembly of Sordland.

The PFJP was established during the Lachaven Congress in 1932 as a union of opposition groups against the government of Tarquin Soll. Traditionally anchored in the center-left of the political spectrum, the party has historically connected with various segments of society, from middle to upper-middle classes, encompassing professionals, government employees, academia, students, progressive thinkers, and union members. 

Internal tensions emerged as the party leadership increasingly diverged from its left-wing supporters, with Bludish voters feeling particularly alienated. This ideological drift was further accelerated by Ricter's embrace of market-oriented economic policies.

They represent the reformist faction of the Grand National Assembly, advocating for a more democratic constitution. The party opposes the constitution written by Tarquin Soll and deems it undemocratic. They are seen as the alternate to the USP and have been a major force in Sordish politics since its first election. 

The PFJP has been steadily increasing its popularity among the Sordish population who are unhappy with their current situation.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: The People’s Freedom and Justice Party

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The United Sordland Party (USP) is a political party in Sordland. It is the oldest political party in the country, and is currently acting as the governing party. As the self-proclaimed unifying force behind Sordland's establishment, the United Sordland Party presents itself as a contemporary democratic organization that adheres to the republic's foundational tenets. Its logo consists of the three arrows shining from a lightbulb, which represent the foundational principles of Sollism: republicanism, nationalism, and statism.

It was founded by Tarquin Soll in 1929, following the end of the Sordish Civil War. It participated in the first elections after the war with no contest and was elected into government. It has been the leading party in Sordish politics since 1929 without any disruptions. In the 1940’s, the party slowly started to protest against Tarquin Soll’s authoritarian policies and strayed from the Sollist ideology.

With the new reformist faction increasing their influence in the 1940’s, Ewald Alphonso called for a congress and managed to win against Tarquin Soll, which made Soll resign from his position as chairman of the USP in 1946. Ewald Alphonso served as the second chairman of the USP and was elected President in 1949. His term saw many changes to the USP with many of the old leadership leaving or being evicted from the party. Alphonso administration pushed for free market reforms which resulted in the Recession of ‘51. This helped Anton Rayne rise up as a young new leader during the tumultuous period of the party with its lost identity.
CodexEntryProperties.Title: United Sordland Party

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Worker's Party of Bludia (WPB) is a Bludish political party in Sordland, which garners most of its support from the Bergia region. Generally left-wing, the party places a strong emphasis on participatory democracy, unions, minority rights and egalitarianism. The party brought great criticism for the usage of the Bludish name (Bludia) for the region of Bergia in its name.

Aspiring to fundamentally challenge the existing Sordish-Bludish divide and other existing parameters in Sordish politics, the WPB was founded in 1948 as the continuation of the Bludish movement started by the Bludish Freedom Party. Despite their name, they claim to be a political party representing the whole region of Bergia and want to represent all of Sordland regardless of ethnic backgrounds, rejecting the label of Bludish nationalism.

Some members of the USP has claimed that the WPB has direct ties with Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) which was not proven and have been numerously denied by its members. In the 1949, the party put forward its earlier chairman, Mansoun Leke, who won 6% of the vote. Leke had then resigned from the party and ran as an independent to bypass the 10% election threshold. In 1953 elections, the party won 9% of the vote, barely losing the elections this time, despite concerns that the departure of Leke may result in lower votes.

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
The Red Youth is a political organization with alleged connections to a number of insurgent attacks against the Sordish government. It was founded in 1923 by a group of revolutionaries, who were inspired by the communist revolution in United Contana and came together to promote Malenyevist ideas during the early days of the republic.

After the military coup in ‘27, they continued for some time as an underground organization. Their members participated in the Sordish Civil War and continued their protests after the war. Throughout the 20’s, they engaged in urban warfare with right-wing militants. Despite heavy crackdown of their forces during Tarquin Soll’s term as president, they managed to gather major support in many universities around Sordland.

Red Youth members participated in the protests against the Arcasian 2nd Fleet anchoring in Sordland in the 1940's, and also played an active role in the workers' actions in the early 1950’s.

CodexEntryProperties.Description:
Young Sords is a right-wing nationalist political organization, with alleged connections to a number of armed attacks against the Sordish government. They are a youth organization that has close ties to the National Front Party. Often it has been associated with the Black Battalion and been linked to the parties more violent wing. The organization often hides behind these claims by highlighting it's cultural works.

The Young Sords was formed by General Luderin in 1927 rising in popularity and participating as a combatant in the Sordish Civil War. It often clashed with other left-wing groups, primarily with Rikardists and for a brief period engaged with Sollist forces. Initially journalists, but later historians identified the entity to have activities corresponding to that of a death squad.

A staunchly pan-Sordist organization, in the early 1930’s, the Young Sords have managed to extend their area of operation into Sordish speaking post-revolution Valgsland. Most people suspect the Young Sords to be part of the Sordish 'Old Guards', and there seems some inconclusive reports that both the Holsord Police and the Supreme Court had dealings with them.
